chapters.title: Chapter 51: Overpowered Skills
paragraphs: [Command received. Upgrading skill... Teleport skill successfully upgraded from Rank S to SSS. Effect enhancement and mastery boost complete.]

[Updated Teleport skill: Earth-Grade, Rank SSS. The teleportation range increased to 2000 meters. Energy efficiency was enhanced by 30%. Skill cooldown reduced, allowing for quicker successive uses with less energy.]
<Not bad, not bad at all. I can now use it even more with less stamina consumption. Not bad at all,> Kent said, pleased with the upgrade.
Being able to teleport 2 km continuously is something nobody at his level of cultivation should be able to do. It’s like he can now move at will, anytime, without making his intentions known.
[The master is indeed lucky. With more upgrades to the ranking and the grades, the master would gain an even more powerful version of the skill.]
<That I will, Tower. I have to ensure I don’t run out of skill points anytime soon,> Kent said, then began contemplating what to do next.
He still has two skills—the [24 String Weaving Strike] and the [Elemental Manipulation] skills—he can upgrade at the moment.

The rank for each is ’S,’ but the 24 String Weaving Strike is an Earth-grade skill, and the Elemental Manipulation skill is a Heaven-grade skill. Clearly, the two are in a different league of their own.
Kent could choose to upgrade the 24 String Weaving Strike, which might unlock a better or more advanced version of it. However, who knew how much progress he would make with that?
On the other hand, he could choose the Elemental Manipulation skill, which he knew would also bring a surprise.
Considering his intelligence had been boosted and he could now master an even more complex Flame technique, who knew what he could achieve with just this rank of the skill?
<Tower, let’s upgrade the 24 String Weaving Strike skill. I still have some points left, right?>
[Yes. The master still has 1,100 skill upgrade points, which he can use to upgrade the 24 String Weaving Strike from S rank to SS.]
<Good. Go ahead.>
[Command received. Upgrading skill... 24 String Weaving Strike skill successfully upgraded from Rank S to SS. Effect enhancement and mastery boost complete.]
[Updated 24 String Weaving Strike skill: Earth-Grade, Rank SS. A new form of the skill has been unlocked. The skill has undergone a name change.]
[New name: 36 String Weaving Strike
Effect: Using 36 strings fashioned from sword qi, unleash any pattern you can visualize with a single swing of your sword.
The stronger your sword qi, the more lethal the strings formed. Additionally, a stronger mental strength is required to comprehend the full form of this skill.]

’This is one great sword skill,’ Kent thought, his blood boiling with excitement as he imagined the true nature of the ability. His master has only given him 24 and he had now unlocked 36, that is just overpowered as fuck.
He now could form any pattern from 36 strings of sword qi. This would even become more lethal since his sword qi is already nearing the enhanced sword qi stage.

This was a dangerously versatile skill, especially considering it was still just an Earth-Grade technique. The thought of how devastating it could become as a Heaven-Grade skill sent a thrill through him.
’I like this skill... it’s going to be my go-to from now on,’ Kent said inwardly, a confident smile spreading across his lips.

With the ability to upgrade skills, Kent could pick any random skill and transform it into something terrifying. The current him was like a cheat, capable of elevating anything, regardless of its nature, to the pinnacle. In a way, he was a monster.
’All that’s left are the [Appraiser’s Eye] and [Elemental Manipulation] skills. I just need to earn more points so I can overpower them, too.’

With that resolve, Kent decided to wait for Lilian to finish her conversation with Vexthra. Since Vexthra was responsible for empowering his women, he could only be patient as she worked with the newest addition to his harem.
A few minutes later, Lilian was done.
"How was it? Do you like her?" Kent asked, smiling at Lilian.
"Of course! I love Big Sister Vexthra. She gave me a divine-grade cultivation technique," Lilian said with a bright, happy smile.
"Good for you. I guess you’ll soon become a very powerful Elemental Mage," Kent replied with a small grin.
"Yes! She even gave me a way to awaken the Ice, Fire, and Water elements. Isn’t that awesome?" Lilian exclaimed excitedly.
"Congratulations in advance, dear. I will make sure you and your sisters remain the happiest people in the entire universe," Kent said, reaching for her hand.
"We will also ensure you become the happiest man in the universe," Lilian said, melting into his arm.
"Happiest man in the universe, you say?" Kent smiled. "How are you going to do that?"
"By doing this." Lilian leaned in, and before Kent could blink, his divine rod entered her mouth as she began servicing it.
"Well, that works." He lay on the bed, allowing her to do her job. A few minutes later, Lilian climbed up, and before he could breathe, his entire length had entered her body.
The next two hours were spent embracing each other. Kent managed to climb one level, becoming a Level 6 Root Ascendant in just a couple of hours.
Once they were done, Kent freshened up and went and spent three hours with Unity. In the end, Unity managed to climb one level, becoming a Level 5 Root Master.
"I will be spending the next few days doing alchemy. So, in the meantime, what will you be doing?" Kent asked, lying on the bed with Unity’s breast pressed against his chest.

"The cultivation technique I got from Sister Vexthra requires me to walk a path. For now, I don’t have any path in mind. However, Big Sister Vexthra recommended the spear or the bow, so I am deciding which path to take.
Also, I need to figure out which element to awaken since I only have one chance to awaken it," Unity explained.
"Well, take your time, and if you need anything, you can come to me," Kent said.

Since she was not a mage but a weapon cultivator like Kent, she could awaken only one element. Of course, Kent’s case was different since he managed to awaken two. However, weapon cultivators usually awakened just one or none at all.

In situations like this, she had to choose carefully to avoid regret later. Of course, with a goddess as the creator of her cultivation technique, she was assured of awakening her element in the safest way possible.
"Okay... I will come to you when I make a decision," Unity said, leaning in for a kiss.
After spending a few more minutes together, Kent left. It was time to push his purity level to 100% before beginning the process of concocting 120 different Tier 0 pills.
He already had thousands of pill recipes to choose from, but for now, he would focus on just 120, enough to break through to the Pill Master stage.

Once he achieved that, he could unlock the Pill Master Primordial Alchemy Records, which contained recipes for Tier 1, Tier 2, and possibly even Tier 3 pills, along with advanced pill refining techniques.
The next few days would be devoted entirely to concocting pills and advancing his alchemy profession to the peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Perfect Purity Level
paragraphs: Right after spending time with Unity, Kent found a room in the new mini-mansion that had been given to him and his master, and he got to work.
He had a lot to do.

First, he needed to take his purity to the perfect stage, which was 100%. Then, he would have to concoct 120 different Tier-0 pills to reach the Pill Master stage. Of course, he had bought more than enough ingredients for this undertaking.
However, before he began concocting, Kent decided to follow the Tower’s advice and learn a new pill-flame control technique:
The Seven Flame Control and Refining Art.

He had tried learning this technique before, but that was back when he was just a Root Blossom cultivator. He may have had a lot of Spiritual Qi in his Dantian at the time, but it wasn’t sufficient for the technique.

So, he had to settle for the minor ones. Essentially, the Seven Flame Control and Refining Art was the skill he was meant to use from the beginning. It wasn’t just a static ability; it would evolve and grow stronger as he progressed in cultivation and in Alchemy.
It was a technique that could take him to the peak—provided he didn’t slack off. And Kent wasn’t about to slack off, not after everything Vexthra had done for him and was still doing for him.
Kent quickly got to work, summoning his Blue Void Flame, and started practicing the technique.
He already had some understanding, having concocted pills before, so it took him just an hour to grasp the full nature of the technique.
Once that was done, he retrieved the ingredients for the Qi Gathering Pill and got started.
Using the Seven Flame Control and Refining Art, he began heating the cauldron. Immediately, there was a noticeable difference in how the pill flame danced around the furnace.

It wasn’t overly dramatic. The technique was designed to be used with seven different pill flames at his current level. However, since he only had one flame at the moment, he focused solely on mastering that one.
After all, he would eventually awaken more flames as he advanced. This also meant the technique would evolve alongside his progress.
It was a growth-oriented technique, one that demanded total dedication to Alchemy if he truly wanted to walk that path until his mission was complete.

Once the cauldron was sufficiently heated, Kent tossed in the first ingredient and began extracting its essence. The process was faster than before, a testament to his improving skills. He swiftly added the second ingredient, and before long, the final one was in the mix.

He then started burning away impurities while gradually condensing the pill. The technique allowed him to do both simultaneously, which not only improved efficiency but also helped him increase his purity level without sacrificing too much essence from the pill.
<Tower, you once said I could practice complete extraction using this technique, right?> Kent asked

[Yes, Master. You can indeed do that. However, you would need to master the technique to a certain level before you can simply dump all the ingredients into the cauldron and extract their essences with ease.]

[Basically, you can begin by practicing with two ingredients. Once you’re proficient, move to three, and as you progress and refine your skill, you can handle more. The more mastery you achieve, the higher your chances of becoming an alchemy genius.]
<I thought I was already an alchemy genius.> Kent smiled slightly, amused by the remark.

[Master is indeed an alchemy genius... at your current level. However, as you climb the ladder of alchemy, you will encounter individuals whose genius surpasses imagination. That being said, Master is undeniably a genius in your own right.]
<I see. So, aside from complete extraction, what other perks would I gain from this technique?>

[Master can also practice batch refining. This means you could refine more than one pill in a single session. There are others out there who can concoct ten or even a hundred pills at once. If Master wishes to dominate the alchemy world, batch pill refining is a path worth pursuing.]
<Ha... I guess I’m just an ant at my current stage. But who knows? I might surpass everyone soon enough.>
Kent smiled, fully aware that he was entering a race. Things were about to get spooky and crazy for him. The alchemy world is large, after all.
But what was a little challenge if one truly wanted to become the best?

He continued refining the pill for 40 minutes until a soft poof came from the cauldron. Smiling, he retrieved the pill. Of course, the Tower wouldn’t disappoint him, even though he had the Appraiser’s Eye to detect the purity level, it decided to show him the outcome instead.
[You have successfully concocted a Qi Gathering Pill. Grade: Tier 0, Quality: Excellent. Purity: 99%.]
"Ha... looks like mastering a new technique will take some time," Kent muttered. "But this is a good start. I just need to try again."
Kent smiled and began concocting another pill.
Since the result wasn’t quite to his liking, he resolved to get more precise this time and address his shortcomings. The next concoction also yielded 99% purity, but he neither panicked nor frowned.
He understood it was only a matter of time before a perfect pill emerged. His confidence and anticipation weren’t misplaced.
After four more trials, he finally achieved his goal.
Opening the cauldron, Kent retrieved a dazzling white pill, its surface gleaming like the purest jade. The Tower wasted no time in praising him, proudly displaying the purity level.
[Congratulations, Master. You have successfully concocted a Qi Gathering Pill. Grade: Tier 0, Quality: Flawless. Purity: 100%. This is a perfect pill.]
Kent’s grin widened as he admired the flawless pill in his hand.
"About damn time," Kent smiled as he retrieved a small box and placed the pill inside. At that very moment, the tower displayed yet another message, making his grin widen.
[You have concocted your first Flawless Pill. Because of your hard work, you have received a new understanding of the Seven Flame Control and Refining Art. Good luck.]
[Progress Level: 1/120 Tier 0 Pills to become a Pill Master.]
Kent smiled again, sensing a change in his understanding of the technique. He retrieved another set of ingredients for a new recipe.

He was about to concoct a strength-enhancing pill next. Some might argue that he should focus on solidifying his progress with the Qi-gathering pill, but that would be a waste of time, considering his newfound understanding of the Seven Flame Control and Refining Art.
Before long, he began concocting the pill. It was a new kind of pill, but since he had the recipe and a powerful refining technique, it took just 45 minutes for the pill to emerge flawless.
[Progress Level: 2/120 Tier 0 Pills to become a Pill Master.]

With his newfound success, he began concocting a variety of pills, one for every recipe he had. He didn’t need to waste much time on them, as in the world of alchemy, it was the Tier 3 pills and above that garnered the most attention.
Of course, Tier 0, 1, and 2 pills were also important, but the pills that could truly disrupt the market came from Tier 3 and beyond. Kent wanted to break into that market as quickly as possible.
And so, he began working even harder.

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Becoming a Pill Master
paragraphs: [You have successfully concocted an Agility Boost Pill. Grade: Tier 0, Quality: Flawless. Purity: 100%.]
[Progress Level: 119/120 Tier 0 Pills to become a Pill Master.]
It had already been five days since Kent began concocting pills. From time to time, he rested to recover his spiritual qi, as the process was taking a greater toll on him than he cared to admit.
That being said, the first day was the hardest. However, after that, the tower proposed a brilliant solution.

Since Kent was already concocting pills, why not make some to help him recover more quickly? With that in mind, he began concocting pills like the Stamina Recovery Pill and, of course, the Qi Gathering Pill.
Thanks to the flawless nature of these pills, Kent could replenish his spiritual qi much faster, and the Stamina Recovery Pill effectively alleviated his recovery even further.

This improvement accelerated his progress, and by the third day, he had already leveled up once, becoming a Level 7 Root Ascendent. This advancement gave him more spiritual qi and energy, enabling him to work many hours without rest.
Kent’s understanding of the Seven Flame Control and Refining Art gradually deepened each day, allowing him to reduce the time it took to concoct each pill.
Every second saved made a difference, boosting his efficiency and filling him with a newfound confidence. He had long been chasing this feeling, and now it was finally within reach.
To Kent, becoming a Pill Master wasn’t just a title. It was a declaration. It meant he had truly stepped onto the path of real alchemy, leaving behind the amateur level granted to him by the tower.
Earning this title through his own skill and effort would solidify his place as a true alchemist. He needed something like that. Something he earned from his hard work.

The challenge of becoming a Pill Master loomed large, but Kent had made incredible progress. Out of the 120 flawless pills required, he had already concocted 119. Just one more pill and the title would be his.
"This is it," Kent murmured, his eyes sparkling with delight. "One more pill and I can confidently claim the title of Pill Master. After that, I’ll aim for Grandmaster and keep climbing from there."
With a smile, he gathered the ingredients for a Minor Defense Pill and got to work. The flames danced under his control, the ingredients merging perfectly.
Forty minutes later, the pill took shape, flawless as always. Kent couldn’t help but smile.
Then, the messages started to appear.
[Congratulations! You have successfully concocted a Minor Defense Pill. Grade: Tier 0, Quality: Flawless. Purity: 100%.]
[Progress Level: 120/120 Tier 0 Pills to become a Pill Master.]
He smiled as he waited for the next set of messages to appear. It didn’t take long.
[You have fulfilled the requirements to become a Pill Master. Your understanding of alchemy has reached a new height. You have received the title Flawless Pill Master.
All pills you concoct will have a 20% boost in vitality, regardless of their purity level.
[You have unlocked the Pill Master Primordial Alchemy Records. You now possess all the knowledge required for the Pill Master Alchemy stage. You can now concoct Tier 1 and Tier 2 pills.]
[To qualify for the next record, you must complete the following challenges:
1. Concoct 60 Tier 1 Flawless Pills.
2. Concoct 60 Tier 2 Flawless Pills.
3. Challenge a Pill Master to a duel and win flawlessly.
4. Concoct a Flawless Tier 3 Pill.
You have six months to accomplish this. Failure will strip you of your current Pill Flame until you somehow manage to complete the challenges.]
"Well, that took a dark turn quickly," Kent muttered, staring at the tasks he must complete to advance to a Pill Grandmaster.
"Not that I’m complaining. I guess this is just another task I need to check off on the long list waiting for me on this path to the peak of alchemy."

Concocting Tier 1 and Tier 2 pills, while challenging, wouldn’t be too much of a struggle for him. After all, with thousands of pill recipes now ingrained in his mind, Kent possesses an immense wealth of knowledge about pill concoctions and medicine.

In addition, he now had plenty of money to spend on ingredients, giving him the freedom to practice as much as he needed to master the art and meet the requirements, which primarily revolved around crafting Flawless Pills.
<Tower, what can you tell me about the title I’ve received? Is it common for Pill Masters?>

[No, Master. Your title is a unique reward granted by the Alchemy Tower. Essentially, the effect of every pill you concoct will be a 20% increase in purity level. For example, if you concoct a pill with an effect that lasts for ten days, this title will enhance it to work for twelve days instead.
It’s a boon that only you can enjoy.]
<That’s the spirit!> Kent grinned at the explanation.
Not only did he have access to countless recipes, but he also carried a buff that applied to every pill he created. That was simply extraordinary.
"I guess it’s a good thing I bought some Tier 1 Pill recipes. Time to concoct the good old Qi Gathering Pill—but this time, at a Tier 1 level instead of Tier 0."
Kent smiled, then began retrieving the ingredients.

Soon, the cauldron heated up, flames dancing around it as Kent began concocting his first Tier 1 pill. Though it was his first attempt at this level, he remained focused, following the process meticulously.
After 56 minutes, a soft poof echoed from the cauldron. The Tower’s messages appeared before him.
[You have successfully concocted a Qi Gathering Pill. Grade: Tier 1, Quality: Excellent. Purity: 99%.]
[The effects of this pill will surpass all others in its tier. Your title’s bonus ensures its potency is enhanced by 20%.]
"99%, huh? Not bad... but I can do better," Kent said with determination.

Without hesitation, he began refining another batch. His movements were smoother this time, and his flame was more controlled. After 50 minutes, the cauldron released another poof, signaling completion.
The Tower’s message appeared once more, and Kent smiled in satisfaction.
[You have successfully concocted a Qi Gathering Pill. Grade: Tier 1, Quality: Flawless. Purity: 100%.]
[The effects of this pill will surpass all others in its tier. Your title’s bonus ensures its potency is enhanced by 20%.]

[Grade: Tier 1]
[Quality: Flawless]
[Purity: 100%]
[Effect:]
> This pill accelerates the user’s Qi gathering by 90 times their normal speed. It lasts for 48 hours.
[Note: Because of the 20% added effect, the pill would work for 58 hours at 108 times the person’s cultivation speed]
Kent grinned, looking at the perfectly crafted pill in his hand. "That’s what I’m talking about."
Kent quickly tossed the pill into his mouth and began cultivating. Although he gets stronger by having sex, that doesn’t mean he can’t cultivate using the traditional way.

That being said, he wanted to see the effect of the pill firsthand before making it public. After all, when word gets out that there is a Flawless pill around, everyone is going to flip, even if it’s just a Tier 0 or Tier 1 pill.
Two days later, Kent opened his eyes with a slight smile. He had leveled up again. He had now become a Level 8 Root Ascendant.
He quickly exhausted his ingredients, concocting five more Flawless Qi Gathering Pills. Once he was done with the last pill, He left the seclusion and wanted to go to Lilian for a steamy session.
However, before he could leave, his master who had left 7 days ago finally returned. Kent went to see her first.

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Aura Stone
paragraphs: "Master, you are back," Kent said as he approached his master. She had been away for the past seven days despite saying she would return in five.
Perhaps she had been too overwhelmed by Kent’s talent and had taken more time than expected to recover her composure.
Not that anyone could blame her... Someone who had only picked up a sword a few days ago had no business wielding sword aura and Sword Intent.
But then again, the world was vast, so who could truly say what was possible and what was not? She just had to accept reality and get used to it.
She has finally calmed down and accepted reality.
But if only that were all—until she noticed Kent’s cultivation base.

"You... You—when did you become a Root Ascendant, and at the peak, no less? I have been gone for only a week!" Saintess Selene exclaimed, her voice trembling with disbelief. What she was witnessing was simply beyond comprehension.

Before leaving, Kent had only been an intermediate Root Blossom expert. She was certain of that, as she had been scanning him ever since their battle at the auction house. She knew that was his true cultivation base.
But now, none of it made sense. Not even in the slightest.

Typically, breaking through a minor realm that fast would be manageable and considered normal, but climbing through an entire major realm and even rising to the peak of a minor realm in such a short time was simply too good to be true.
"I worked hard for it, Master," Kent said with a smile.
Indeed, he had worked very hard for it.
"Just what kind of monster have I entangled myself with?" Saintess Selene muttered, a little too loudly for Kent not to hear.
He simply smiled and decided not to tease her further. The woman had just recovered from one shock; adding more might leave her even more agitated.
But Selene’s thoughts ran in a different direction. "Were you hiding your cultivation base somehow when we met?" she asked.
"No, Master," Kent replied.
"Then how did you rise from intermediate Root Blossom to the Root Ascendant stage within a week?" she asked, her tone laced with suspicion.

"First, I am a hard worker; second, I am an Alchemist; and third, I have a great body. Put all this together, and you can only imagine what can happen within a week," Kent replied with a confident smile.
He knew she didn’t need to know about the Dual Cultivation yet. They hadn’t reached that level of trust—or more like thrust yet.
"Are you telling me you somehow managed to raise your cultivation base using Alchemy?" she asked, raising an eyebrow.
"I may be a swordswoman, but I know a thing or two about alchemy. At your current level, you shouldn’t have the capability to achieve something this heaven-defying."

"I suppose that may be true for most alchemists out there. But I’m different, Master," Kent said with a grin. He pulled out a pill and handed it to her. "I don’t concoct tainted pills, Master. I only concoct Flawless, perfect pills."
Her eyes widened as she sensed the purity level of the pill. "This..." she whispered, utterly stunned.

"No need to be shocked, Master; your disciple is multitalented. My swordsmanship is impeccable. I’m also skilled with flame manipulation, and soon, I’ll show you my expertise in other fields." Kent winked mischievously.
"Unbelievable..." Saintess Selene muttered, shaking her head.
"Just who are you, and how has nobody discovered your existence yet? In fact, if anyone had, they would have locked you away and forced you to become their slave alchemist by now."
Saintess Selene sighed deeply.
"How about it, Master? Will you turn me into your slave alchemist? Not that I would mind. Being a slave to such a beauty feels only natural," Kent said with a smile.
[Nice line, Master. And don’t worry—no matter the strength of the slave seal placed on you, it would have no effect. Goddess Vexthra has ensured that.
But even without her protection, I wouldn’t let any seal affect you unless you wanted me to stay out of it.]
<Something like that exists?> Kent was both shocked and relieved.
"Don’t talk nonsense, Kent. I am your master; I would never let anyone harm you, much less think of harming you myself," Saintess Selene said, her tone slightly serious.
"I was just joking, Master. No need to be so serious," Kent replied with a grin.
"I know. But that being said, I want you to grow stronger. I know for a fact that within a month, your identity as someone who can concoct perfect pills will be made known.
I want you to be able to protect yourself while I handle the more significant threats," Saintess Selene vowed, prompting Kent to nod in agreement.
If he was going to walk a path that would one day bring him face-to-face with the God of Alchemy, then he couldn’t cower in fear now.
He had to brave the danger and rise above it... That was the only way to the top.

"That aside, take this and use the next few days to absorb and refine the energy within it," Saintess Selene said as she took out a stone the size of an adult’s fist. The moment it was revealed, sharp energies filled the room, threatening to cut Kent’s body.
[Master, that’s an Aura Stone, and from its looks, it’s meant for swordsmen. To think she went through so much trouble to retrieve something like this... I guess she really cares about you.]
<Is it that valuable?> Kent asked.
[Very valuable and incredibly difficult to obtain. And from its appearance, it seems freshly retrieved,] the tower replied, making Kent raise an eyebrow.
"Master... What is it?" he asked, feigning ignorance.
"It’s an Aura Stone for swordsmen. Absorbing its energy will significantly boost your sword aura. But you mustn’t expose it for long—the longer it stays out, the less potent it becomes."
"Wow... what a valuable treasure. It must have cost a fortune," Kent said with a small smile.
"Don’t worry about that. I retrieved it myself, so no money was spent. Now, hurry up and absorb it," Saintess Selene said, waving him away.
Kent, however, activated his appraiser’s eye and noticed that her muscles were tense, and her posture screamed exhaustion. Clearly, acquiring such a treasure wasn’t as easy as she made it seem.
<Tower, how hard is retrieving this kind of Aura Stone?> Kent asked.

[Master, retrieving an Aura Stone is extremely dangerous. They are born in chaotic energy zones, often guarded by powerful beasts or surrounded by natural hazards. This one looks like it came from a high-tier zone. The energy in it is very potent]
Kent reached and took the stone from his master. Her movements were steady, but he could see the fatigue in her eyes and the tension in her shoulders. Without hesitation, he made up his mind.
"Master, why don’t I give you a massage to reduce your fatigue?" Kent offered with a grin.
Selene froze, narrowing her eyes at him. "You... what are you talking about?"

"No need to be alarmed, Master," Kent replied, raising his hands in mock surrender. "I can tell you’re stressed. So, allow me to help you relax. And stop—whatever you’re thinking about, just stop. I’m only offering a shoulder massage."
Selene’s expression shifted between suspicion and embarrassment, her lips twitching as she processed his words.
Kent couldn’t help but laugh at her funny expression. "Come on, Master, don’t make that face. I promise I’ll be professional."

chapters.title: Chapter 55: Passed out From A Shoulder Massage
paragraphs: Kent continued to stare at his Master, who was struggling to trust him. Not that she was entirely wrong. But as a Master, she needed to trust her disciple enough to let him support her, even in dangerous situations.
A shoulder massage wasn’t something to be taken lightly for someone like her, who hadn’t allowed any man to touch her in hundreds of years.
She truly embodied the title of Saintess. Because of her delicate nature and the way she carried herself, having a man’s hands on her shoulders was the last thing she wanted.
Yet here she was, hesitating to reject the offer. Deep down, a part of her was curious. She wanted to know how it would feel.
Call it curiosity, but Kent’s daring nature intrigued her. She wanted to see where he intended to take this.
So, for the first time in 197 years, the Saintess decided to let a man place his fingers on her body, even if it was through her clothes.
"Okay... but before you get any weird ideas, know that I will be watching with my Divine Sense. If you try anything funny, I’ll take you down—disciple or not," she warned.
’What an uptight woman. I guess she hasn’t had a proper massage in forever. But don’t worry Master; soon, you’ll be getting more than just a massage,’ Kent grinned inwardly.
"Don’t worry, Master; I won’t do anything weird. That being said, let’s head to your bedroom," Kent said, standing up.
"Wait, why not here? Why should we go to the bedroom?" Saintess Selene asked, narrowing her eyes suspiciously.

"Chill, Master, no need to be alarmed. I’m suggesting the bedroom because, once I’m done, you might pass out. Unless you want me to carry you like a princess to your bed—which, let’s be honest, you probably wouldn’t want—this is more practical.
I mean, I wouldn’t mind. Carrying you like a princess would be a dream come true for any man," Kent said with a small smile, one that hinted at something deeper.
"Fine. Let’s go."
With that, Kent followed his master, making sure his eyes never left the way her hips swayed enticingly as she walked.
’I’ll tap that soon,’ he muttered inwardly, as though sealing a promise to himself.

"Just sit on the bed and relax your body. It’ll only take a few minutes, so try to relax your body. Passing out would be like winning a sword battle against you," Kent said with a playful smirk, moving closer as Selene sat on the bed.
"I’m going to touch your shoulders now," Kent added, extending his hand. Just before his fingers made contact, he discreetly activated the [Divine Pervert’s Touch].
He quickly desires to calm her body down.
It worked like magic. The moment his hands rested on her shoulders, her body relaxed almost instinctively. Her heartbeat quickened for a brief moment before steadying into a tranquil rhythm.

’What is this strange feeling? How is he doing that?’ Saintess Selene wondered, immediately activating her divine sense to probe what was happening. However, no matter how deeply she inspected, she couldn’t detect anything unusual.
All her divine senses revealed was Kent’s hands methodically massaging her shoulders with a controlled, soothing rhythm. Yet, the sensations her body was experiencing told a different story.

It felt as though an unseen energy was flowing into her, spreading a profound sense of calm throughout her entire being. Oddly, the energy wasn’t invasive or harmful—it simply melted away her tension.

The mismatch between what she saw and what she felt left her puzzled. But within seconds, her once-fatigued body began to loosen further, and her stiff, overworked muscles softened under Kent’s careful touch.
If only she knew, things could have been a little more invasive.
The Divine Pervert’s Touch skill perhaps shouldn’t go by that name.
It should be more like Divine Desire Touch. All Kent had to do was think—or, more precisely, desire—and it would manifest that desire through his touch.
A very powerful skill with countless applications.
The skill was simply too versatile. At the moment, Kent was using it to do two things for his master:
First, he eased her fatigue and loosened her stiff muscles. Then, he worked to calm her as much as possible. The rest would rely on her body’s natural response.
Of course, if Kent wanted to, he could have forced his mental strength to put her to sleep. But that would have been intrusive, especially since he had promised not to do anything inappropriate.
It didn’t matter much, as two minutes into the massage, Saintess Selene was already feeling her eyes grow heavy.
’I feel...sleepy,’ she muttered inwardly, her senses dulling further.
’I have to trust him. He said he wouldn’t do anything bad to my body, so I have to trust him.’ Accepting that she couldn’t hold on much longer, she decided to place her dignity in Kent’s hands.
She could only trust him. After all, what kind of master would she be if she couldn’t trust her own disciple?
"Kent, I will leave my body in your care. I trust you won’t violate it," Saintess Selene said before relinquishing all the resistance she held within her body.

The moment she let go, she felt an immediate sense of calm wash over her. The sensation she had been resisting began to flow freely through her, bringing a soothing warmth to every fiber of her being.
Within seconds, her senses dulled, and for the first time in many years, Saintess Selene closed her eyes and drifted into a deep, peaceful sleep.
Kent, noticing his master had fallen asleep, carefully laid her on the bed and stood up. He gazed at her tranquil face and smiled softly.
"Don’t worry, Master. With me around, you won’t have to worry about anything. This disciple will care for you in ways you never imagined possible."
After whispering those words, Kent left the room. He headed straight to Unity’s dwelling, where he spent several hours embracing each other.
Once done, he visited Lilian and shared a few rounds of sex with her as well. By the time he was finished, he could feel his cultivation nearing a breakthrough.
Having reached the peak of Level eight, he was just a step away from ascending to the Root Master stage.
But despite the temptation to force the breakthrough by spending more time with Lilian, he refrained. Instead, he returned to his room and retrieved the Aura Stone from his space ring.
< Tower, you said absorbing this would help me break through, correct? > Kent asked.

[Yes. Aura Stones come in various grades. In this world, there should only be four: Low, Medium, High, and Rare. The one you have is a High-grade Aura Stone, so it should provide more than enough energy to not only push your Sword Aura to the next level but also strengthen other aspects of your cultivation.]
<Alright then.>
Kent sighed, then sat cross-legged and activated his cultivation technique, the Primordial Infinity Dragon Art. He began channeling the energy from the Aura Stone.
Immediately, profound changes started to occur.

sentences.text: Kent continued to stare at his Master, who was struggling to trust him.
Not that she was entirely wrong.
But as a Master, she needed to trust her disciple enough to let him support her, even in dangerous situations.
A shoulder massage wasn’t something to be taken lightly for someone like her, who hadn’t allowed any man to touch her in hundreds of years.
She truly embodied the title of Saintess.
Because of her delicate nature and the way she carried herself, having a man’s hands on her shoulders was the last thing she wanted.
Yet here she was, hesitating to reject the offer.
Deep down, a part of her was curious.
She wanted to know how it would feel.
Call it curiosity, but Kent’s daring nature intrigued her.
She wanted to see where he intended to take this.
So, for the first time in 197 years, the Saintess decided to let a man place his fingers on her body, even if it was through her clothes.
"Okay... but before you get any weird ideas, know that I will be watching with my Divine Sense.
If you try anything funny, I’ll take you down—disciple or not," she warned.
’What an uptight woman.
I guess she hasn’t had a proper massage in forever.
But don’t worry Master; soon, you’ll be getting more than just a massage,’ Kent grinned inwardly.
"Don’t worry, Master; I won’t do anything weird.
That being said, let’s head to your bedroom," Kent said, standing up.
"Wait, why not here?
Why should we go to the bedroom?" Saintess Selene asked, narrowing her eyes suspiciously.
"Chill, Master, no need to be alarmed.
I’m suggesting the bedroom because, once I’m done, you might pass out.
Unless you want me to carry you like a princess to your bed—which, let’s be honest, you probably wouldn’t want—this is more practical.
I mean, I wouldn’t mind.
Carrying you like a princess would be a dream come true for any man," Kent said with a small smile, one that hinted at something deeper.
"Fine.
Let’s go."
With that, Kent followed his master, making sure his eyes never left the way her hips swayed enticingly as she walked.
’I’ll tap that soon,’ he muttered inwardly, as though sealing a promise to himself.
"Just sit on the bed and relax your body.
It’ll only take a few minutes, so try to relax your body.
Passing out would be like winning a sword battle against you," Kent said with a playful smirk, moving closer as Selene sat on the bed.
"I’m going to touch your shoulders now," Kent added, extending his hand.
Just before his fingers made contact, he discreetly activated the [Divine Pervert’s Touch].
He quickly desires to calm her body down.
It worked like magic.
The moment his hands rested on her shoulders, her body relaxed almost instinctively.
Her heartbeat quickened for a brief moment before steadying into a tranquil rhythm.
’What is this strange feeling?
How is he doing that?’ Saintess Selene wondered, immediately activating her divine sense to probe what was happening.
However, no matter how deeply she inspected, she couldn’t detect anything unusual.
All her divine senses revealed was Kent’s hands methodically massaging her shoulders with a controlled, soothing rhythm.
Yet, the sensations her body was experiencing told a different story.
It felt as though an unseen energy was flowing into her, spreading a profound sense of calm throughout her entire being.
Oddly, the energy wasn’t invasive or harmful—it simply melted away her tension.
The mismatch between what she saw and what she felt left her puzzled.
But within seconds, her once-fatigued body began to loosen further, and her stiff, overworked muscles softened under Kent’s careful touch.
If only she knew, things could have been a little more invasive.
The Divine Pervert’s Touch skill perhaps shouldn’t go by that name.
It should be more like Divine Desire Touch.
All Kent had to do was think—or, more precisely, desire—and it would manifest that desire through his touch.
A very powerful skill with countless applications.
The skill was simply too versatile.
At the moment, Kent was using it to do two things for his master:
First, he eased her fatigue and loosened her stiff muscles.
Then, he worked to calm her as much as possible.
The rest would rely on her body’s natural response.
Of course, if Kent wanted to, he could have forced his mental strength to put her to sleep.
But that would have been intrusive, especially since he had promised not to do anything inappropriate.
It didn’t matter much, as two minutes into the massage, Saintess Selene was already feeling her eyes grow heavy.
’I feel...sleepy,’ she muttered inwardly, her senses dulling further.
’I have to trust him.
He said he wouldn’t do anything bad to my body, so I have to trust him.’ Accepting that she couldn’t hold on much longer, she decided to place her dignity in Kent’s hands.
She could only trust him.
After all, what kind of master would she be if she couldn’t trust her own disciple?
"Kent, I will leave my body in your care.
I trust you won’t violate it," Saintess Selene said before relinquishing all the resistance she held within her body.
The moment she let go, she felt an immediate sense of calm wash over her.
The sensation she had been resisting began to flow freely through her, bringing a soothing warmth to every fiber of her being.
Within seconds, her senses dulled, and for the first time in many years, Saintess Selene closed her eyes and drifted into a deep, peaceful sleep.
Kent, noticing his master had fallen asleep, carefully laid her on the bed and stood up.
He gazed at her tranquil face and smiled softly.
"Don’t worry, Master.
With me around, you won’t have to worry about anything.
This disciple will care for you in ways you never imagined possible."
After whispering those words, Kent left the room.
He headed straight to Unity’s dwelling, where he spent several hours embracing each other.
Once done, he visited Lilian and shared a few rounds of sex with her as well.
By the time he was finished, he could feel his cultivation nearing a breakthrough.
Having reached the peak of Level eight, he was just a step away from ascending to the Root Master stage.
But despite the temptation to force the breakthrough by spending more time with Lilian, he refrained.
Instead, he returned to his room and retrieved the Aura Stone from his space ring.

[Yes.
Aura Stones come in various grades.
In this world, there should only be four: Low, Medium, High, and Rare.
The one you have is a High-grade Aura Stone, so it should provide more than enough energy to not only push your Sword Aura to the next level but also strengthen other aspects of your cultivation.]

He began channeling the energy from the Aura Stone.
Immediately, profound changes started to occur.

chapters.title: Chapter 56: Sword Body Awakening
paragraphs: Kent placed the Aura Stone on the ground and began absorbing its energy. The process was similar to drawing energy from the air to strengthen one’s cultivation base. All it required was to focus on the stone, and the energy would naturally flow into the body.
From there, the energy had to be guided through the body into the dantian, where it would temper the sword aura.

However, in Kent’s case, things were much simpler. The process activated automatically when he accessed his cultivation technique. He didn’t need to concentrate or guide the energy—it was all seamless for him.

As the energy surged into his body, Kent felt a powerful warmth spreading through his core. His aura began to grow stronger, radiating with a faint silver glow. The sword aura within him sharpened like a blade being honed to perfection.
"Is it supposed to be this fast, Tower?" Kent asked.

[No, Master. It is because of the mutation in your cultivation technique. Your cultivation technique is now automated. So whenever you are near an energy source, all you have to do is give it the green light, and it will start working.]
"How awesome," Kent remarked.
Suddenly, Kent’s aura began to surge as more and more energy was absorbed into him. His sword aura started to intensify, becoming sharper—much sharper by the second.
"I guess the Tower wasn’t exaggerating when it said the aura stone was something every swordsman would cherish," Kent muttered.

Suddenly, the Tower began displaying messages. However, Kent paid them little attention. When the first message appeared, his shirt was instantly burned to ash, revealing intricate markings that started to emerge on his skin.
The stone on the ground was immediately drained of its energy.
[Your bloodline is reacting to the Sword Aura... Your bloodline has fused with your Sword Aura.]
[You have triggered a sword body awakening... Requirement met to awaken sword body]
[Sword Body awakening in progress...]
[You have awakened your Sword Body: Chaos Draconic Divine Sword Body.]
[You have absorbed enough aura. Your Sword Aura has leveled up to Enhanced Sword Aura.]
[Congratulations... Because of the awakening of the sword body, the Sword Tower has partially awakened.]
[The next level of the Sword Mind has been unlocked; 10,002 sword moves have been added to the Sword Mind.]
"Damn, what happened, Tower? Why do I feel like my body has now become a sword?" Kent asked, examining his hand.
Everything happened so fast that he didn’t know just how to describe it.
The runes were glowing faintly around it. It felt like an illusion. Even looking at them made him feel nostalgic. It felt like he had experienced it before, yet he didn’t know from where or when.
[The master has awakened his sword body, meaning you can now be called a master Swordsman. However, you have to earn that by practicing the 10,002 sword moves and mastering all 10,002]
"Interesting," Kent said, pondering on something. A few seconds later, he said, "Tower, show me the description of my sword body."
[Class: Swordsman]
[Trait: Sword Aura | Sword Intent | Sword Body]
[Aspects: Draconic Strength | Chaos Energy Infusion | Draconic Skin]
[Legacy: Chaos Blade (Locked)]
[Sword Body: Chaos Draconic Divine Sword Body (Level 1: Fledging)]
-- The Chaos Draconic Divine Sword Body is a legendary sword cultivation physique that merges the destructive power of chaos, the primal strength of dragons, and the divine mastery of swordsmanship.
[Traits: 2/2]
>Sword Aura (Enhanced): It enhances sword techniques with a subtle, constant energy flow. This makes attacks more precise and powerful.
> Sword Intent (Enhanced): A mental state that focuses the cultivator’s willpower, mastery, and presence, turning the sword into a weapon of spiritual destruction.
[Aspects: 3/3]
> Draconic Strength: When using the sword, your body will gain the strength of a dragon, giving you a tenfold boost in your strength attribute.
> Chaos Energy Infusion: Though not fully awakened, when using the sword, your sword aura will inherit the strength of chaos energy, amplifying it by a hundred times.
>Draconic Skin: Your skin has now hardened, and all attacks will be nullified by 80% while you are using the sword.
"Wow, this is just too much to take in," Kent sighed, reading the descriptions. It looked too good to be true; however, looking at the runes on his body, he could tell it was real.
Plus, he could even feel the strength coursing through him, even without holding a sword.
"Tower, why are the runes dimming now?" Kent asked immediately as he noticed the runes flickering out.

[Your sword body has finished merging with your bloodline. As you cultivate, your sword body will continue to grow. However, the Master is advised to look for more treasures with sword-type energy within them to absorb.]
"What about the legacy? What is it, and why is it locked?"
[The legacy is a sword you will inherit when the Sword Tower fully awakens. It’s a sword that will better suit your sword body.]
"I see. Then I have to look for more of these treasures and see how far they can take me," Kent said before standing up. The aura stone had been sucked dry, and he could only wish he had more of it.
"I guess I can start practicing the Sword Mind now." Kent quickly picked up his sword and went to an open space right behind the small mansion he was staying in with his master.
"Tower, how do I go forward with this new upgrade?" Kent asked.
[The Master just needs to focus on the technique, and he will know what to do.]
Kent opened and closed his eyes, then began focusing on the Sword Mind technique. Immediately, images began flashing before his eyes.
Images of different sword moves flickered before him for thirty minutes before they stopped. When they did, Kent felt his mind filled with 10,002 sword moves—all foreign to him.
"I guess that’s what I was looking for," he muttered. With a sigh, he drew the sword and placed the sheath down.
He then focused his attention on the 10,002 moves and began practicing. He moved in sync with the techniques imprinted in his mind, each motion flowing seamlessly from the next.
His mind was immediately absorbed in the movements. The sword in his hand began glowing faintly with sword qi, and his sword intent gradually spread, encompassing the area around him.

The process just clicked the moment he started the movement and soon, he was deep into it. Ten Hours passed within the blink of an eye yet Kent wasn’t showing any signs of coming out of the weird state he was in.

Twenty hours passed, and he was still at it. By this point, his sword qi had grown much more pronounced, radiating visibly around him. His sword intent, too, had intensified significantly as he continued honing his techniques.
While this might seem extraordinary to many, the truth was that Kent had only mastered 402 moves so far despite the 20 hours of continuous practice.

But results, however, were starting to show. Although he had just started, the signs were showing. Of course, that was just the initial stages of the path he chose to walk. His inheritance came with a sword path, the Genesis path, and Kent had just started walking that path.
Of course, he wouldn’t realize this until he completed all 10,002 sword moves. Yet, even at this early stage, he had unknowingly started showing the signs.
According to the Tower, although his current status was that of a sword master, he would only earn the title of a true sword master after mastering every one of those 10,002 moves.
And thus, Kent’s journey as a true swordsman had just begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Master, were you spying on me
paragraphs: It had been three days since Saintess Selene fell asleep from Kent’s gentle shoulder massage. It was a refreshing experience for her, as, despite not needing sleep like mortals, sleeping for so long was something she had never anticipated.
She had been sleeping for the past three days. That wouldn’t have been possible, but thanks to Kent’s gentle touches, he only woke up after 3 days of good sleep.
"Hmm... I have overslept," she muttered, immediately realizing she had indeed slept longer than expected.
She examined her body to ensure Kent had kept his word and had not done anything intrusive. Of course, it only took a few seconds for her to confirm her suspicions.
"I guess he has some dignity," she muttered before standing from the bed and walking toward the window.
The air carried the scent of pine and other fragrant plants and flowers that surrounded the mansion she was staying in.
"Huh..." Her expression suddenly shifted as she sensed something strong emanating from a part of the mansion. Quickly extending her senses, she located Kent practicing his sword techniques.
Sweat trickled down his body as he moved in graceful arcs, his sword slicing through the air with precision.

It had also been three days since Kent began training, and he had not taken a single day of rest. In fact, he seemed entirely absorbed in his practice, never once stopping to take a moment of rest or even drink water.
"How interesting," she murmured, her expression brightening.
She flew out of the window and landed 500 meters away from Kent. Hiding behind a tree, she began watching him up close.
Her gaze locked onto his every move, but soon, her eyes began to move to his shirtless body, now glistening with sweat.
This of course started to take her focus away from what she came there to do. Instead of analyzing his sword moves, she found herself distracted by Kent’s incredibly refined physique.
However, her thoughts quickly shifted when she noticed something remarkable about his body.
"This... This... How is this possible? How has he already awakened a sword body?" Saintess Selene’s mouth fell open in shock.
"Sword aura was normal. Sword intent was manageable, but this sword body... He hasn’t even reached the Grandmaster stage yet." She was struggling to believe what she was seeing.
In her understanding, one could only awaken a sword body after becoming a Sword Saint. She herself had only recently achieved this and was still working toward the next stage.
Yet here was Kent—someone who had only begun wielding a sword a few weeks ago—already displaying something that defied all logic.
Scratch that. At his level, he shouldn’t even have sword intent. And even if he did, it shouldn’t have progressed to the enhanced stage. It was utterly inconceivable.
And now, a sword body? Her mind reeled. Her thoughts seemed to falter as she tried to process the impossibility of the situation.
In the short time she had known Kent, he had already managed to shock her countless times. Nothing about him seemed to follow the natural order of things.

"Just who is this young man?" she muttered, sneaking another glance at him. Kent, utterly absorbed in his training, remained oblivious to her presence. For another day, he continued his relentless practice, showing no signs of stopping.
Then, on the fifth day, he suddenly halted.
A smirk formed on his face as soon as he stopped. He smiled and then using the teleport skill, he moved away.
In the next instant, he was standing right in front of Saintess Selene, who was immediately startled and let out a small gasp of fright.
"Master, were you spying on me?" Kent asked with a small smile, his eyes meeting hers.
"Ahem... No... I was just observing your training. Good job with the training," she replied in an awkward tone, clearly trying to compose herself.
"Oh, really? Then maybe next time, you should come closer. Hiding behind a tree for two days makes you look like a creep," Kent said, his smile unwavering.
"I didn’t want to disturb you, that’s all," she retorted, unwilling to admit she had indeed been spying.
"I see. By the way, I’m now a Master Swordsman... cool, right?" Kent said, looking unusually cheerful for reasons she couldn’t quite grasp.

It had been five days since he began his intense training. Out of the 10,002 sword moves he was tasked with mastering, he had only perfected 4,000 so far. Though he was far from meeting the Sword Tower’s lofty standards, his progress was astounding.

"Congratulations on awakening a Sword Body, too," Saintess Selene said with a small smile, masking her lingering astonishment. Deep down, she could only hope for a future where she remained relevant in his life.
"I told you I was going to make you proud. This is just the tip of the iceberg," Kent said confidently, his smile widening as he brandished his sword.
"Look at this, Master," he added, swinging his sword in a fluid and precise motion.

As soon as he did, 36 glowing strings of sword qi materialized, slicing forward with incredible force. A nearby tree was instantly cut into 36 distinct pieces, each section falling with surgical precision.
"Wait... How are there 36 strings instead of 24?" Saintess Selene asked, her sharp gaze narrowing as she quickly analyzed the technique.
"It’s 36 now, Master. I’ve evolved the skill," Kent replied with a small smile. "Cool, right?" he added.

"I don’t get it. Skills cannot be evolved that easily. You have to learn them and understand the smallest details about them before you can even think of upgrading. So then, how did you do it?" she asked.
"That is my secret, Master. But don’t worry, I will tell you everything soon. For now, just know that your new disciple is the real deal," Kent said.
He extended his hand and then his sword sheath began to move toward him. A second later, it flew into his hand.
As a soul item, it didn’t matter where it was; as long as its master willed it, it would come.
"Unbelievable..." Saintess Selene, shaking her head. Once again, she chose to accept reality and move on.
"By the way, Master, how was your nap? Enjoyable?" Kent asked with a smile.
"I suppose," Saintess Selene muttered.
"Good to hear you liked it."
"I never said anything like that."
"You didn’t have to say anything, Master. Your cheek is doing all the talking," Kent said with a sly grin.
Saintess Selene touched her cheeks with both hands before turning away. Her cheeks were turning red. Clearly, she was embarrassed.
She wanted to walk off, but Kent took her arm before she could.

"No need to be embarrassed, Master. It’s only natural for a disciple to ensure their master is well cared for. So, whenever you need a massage, let me know. I’ll ensure your body is always calm and healthy so you can teach me better."
They began walking back to the mansion, Kent’s arm still around her. He was treating it so casually that he didn’t notice the flustered expression on her cheeks.
Saintess Selene, now in a man’s arms and surrounded by Kent’s masculine scent, felt strange sensations coursing through her body—feelings she didn’t understand.
Nevertheless, she didn’t hate the feelings stirring within her, so she continued walking with him. The thought of letting go of his arm never crossed her mind.

Soon, they were back in the mansion, and Kent went to take his bath. A short while later, he decided to head out to the city to buy some more ingredients and, well...to go see a certain manager who had been expecting him for days now.

It was utterly inconceivable.
And now, a sword body?
Her mind reeled.
Her thoughts seemed to falter as she tried to process the impossibility of the situation.
In the short time she had known Kent, he had already managed to shock her countless times.
Nothing about him seemed to follow the natural order of things.
"Just who is this young man?" she muttered, sneaking another glance at him.
Kent, utterly absorbed in his training, remained oblivious to her presence.
For another day, he continued his relentless practice, showing no signs of stopping.
Then, on the fifth day, he suddenly halted.
A smirk formed on his face as soon as he stopped.
He smiled and then using the teleport skill, he moved away.
In the next instant, he was standing right in front of Saintess Selene, who was immediately startled and let out a small gasp of fright.
"Master, were you spying on me?" Kent asked with a small smile, his eyes meeting hers.
"Ahem...
No...
I was just observing your training.
Good job with the training," she replied in an awkward tone, clearly trying to compose herself.
"Oh, really?
Then maybe next time, you should come closer.
Hiding behind a tree for two days makes you look like a creep," Kent said, his smile unwavering.
"I didn’t want to disturb you, that’s all," she retorted, unwilling to admit she had indeed been spying.
"I see.
By the way, I’m now a Master Swordsman... cool, right?" Kent said, looking unusually cheerful for reasons she couldn’t quite grasp.
It had been five days since he began his intense training.
Out of the 10,002 sword moves he was tasked with mastering, he had only perfected 4,000 so far.
Though he was far from meeting the Sword Tower’s lofty standards, his progress was astounding.
"Congratulations on awakening a Sword Body, too," Saintess Selene said with a small smile, masking her lingering astonishment.
Deep down, she could only hope for a future where she remained relevant in his life.
"I told you I was going to make you proud.
This is just the tip of the iceberg," Kent said confidently, his smile widening as he brandished his sword.
"Look at this, Master," he added, swinging his sword in a fluid and precise motion.
As soon as he did, 36 glowing strings of sword qi materialized, slicing forward with incredible force.
A nearby tree was instantly cut into 36 distinct pieces, each section falling with surgical precision.
"Wait...
How are there 36 strings instead of 24?" Saintess Selene asked, her sharp gaze narrowing as she quickly analyzed the technique.
"It’s 36 now, Master.
I’ve evolved the skill," Kent replied with a small smile.
"Cool, right?" he added.
"I don’t get it.
Skills cannot be evolved that easily.
You have to learn them and understand the smallest details about them before you can even think of upgrading.
So then, how did you do it?" she asked.
"That is my secret, Master.
But don’t worry, I will tell you everything soon.
For now, just know that your new disciple is the real deal," Kent said.
He extended his hand and then his sword sheath began to move toward him.
A second later, it flew into his hand.
As a soul item, it didn’t matter where it was; as long as its master willed it, it would come.
"Unbelievable..." Saintess Selene, shaking her head.
Once again, she chose to accept reality and move on.
"By the way, Master, how was your nap?
Enjoyable?" Kent asked with a smile.
"I suppose," Saintess Selene muttered.
"Good to hear you liked it."
"I never said anything like that."
"You didn’t have to say anything, Master.
Your cheek is doing all the talking," Kent said with a sly grin.
Saintess Selene touched her cheeks with both hands before turning away.
Her cheeks were turning red.
Clearly, she was embarrassed.
She wanted to walk off, but Kent took her arm before she could.
"No need to be embarrassed, Master.
It’s only natural for a disciple to ensure their master is well cared for.
So, whenever you need a massage, let me know.
I’ll ensure your body is always calm and healthy so you can teach me better."
They began walking back to the mansion, Kent’s arm still around her.
He was treating it so casually that he didn’t notice the flustered expression on her cheeks.
Saintess Selene, now in a man’s arms and surrounded by Kent’s masculine scent, felt strange sensations coursing through her body—feelings she didn’t understand.
Nevertheless, she didn’t hate the feelings stirring within her, so she continued walking with him.
The thought of letting go of his arm never crossed her mind.
Soon, they were back in the mansion, and Kent went to take his bath.
A short while later, he decided to head out to the city to buy some more ingredients and, well...to go see a certain manager who had been expecting him for days now.

chapters.title: Chapter 58: Li Hua
paragraphs: "Master, I am going to the city to buy some ingredients. Please don’t follow me. Use this time to relax," Kent said after freshening up.
"Who said anything about following you?" Saintess Selene chuckled lightly before turning and walking away.
"At least she won’t be following me," Kent muttered under his breath before heading out. He found Uncle Drew, and before long, they departed from Alderford Mansion.

Standing by a window, Saintess Selene watched the carriage roll away with a complicated expression. A part of her wanted to follow him, but another part felt compelled to respect her disciple’s wishes. In the end, she chose to trust him and returned to her meditation.
Kent, now en route with Uncle Drew, grinned as the tower confirmed Saintess Selene had decided not to follow him.
<It seems she’s starting to trust me now,> Kent said to the tower.

Her trust was the first step, and it wouldn’t be long before he began taking things further. After all, though Saintess Selene remained oblivious, her mischievous disciple had already set his sights on seducing her and making her his woman.
Soon enough, one of the oldest and most virtuous maidens in Althea might find herself losing her flower.
"Young Master Kent, I can only go this far," Uncle Drew said as they reached the bustling heart of the city.

"Don’t worry, Uncle Drew, I’ll walk from here," Kent replied, leaping down from the carriage. Without wasting a moment, he melted into the throng of people, heading directly to the herb store where he had purchased the pills a few days prior.
Along the way, the gaze of the ladies never left his body. They were all admiring him, considering his appearance akin to that of a prince from a distant kingdom.
[Looks like there are some cats hungry for a fish, Master,] the tower commented.
<Maybe I should have disguised myself a little,> Kent said to the tower.
[That would be robbing you of potential cultivation partners.]

<So we’re calling them cultivation partners now? I thought we decided to call them cats,> Kent almost laughed. While he planned to have fun with the ladies, he never truly intended to sleep with just any woman he saw.
That would be too ordinary. Of course, he wouldn’t mind getting into the pants of a lady he found appealing.

However, after a year of having sex every single day with a goddess, his standards had risen. While he wouldn’t pursue just any woman, the ones he would go after would undoubtedly be some of the kingdom’s most stunning beauties.
And the ones he would add to his harem would be even more extraordinary.

The tower had told him that if he wanted to get the most out of the Harem Tower, he should hurry and become a Root Grandmaster. This way, once he gained access to the Towers, he would understand why not everyone could be part of his harem.
Kent, engrossed in his back-and-forth conversation with the tower, failed to notice that someone had blocked his path just as he was passing in front of a cake store.
"Big brother, I’m selling banana cake. Do you want to taste some and then buy?" a little girl asked, making Kent stop in his tracks.
If he hadn’t, he might have stepped on her. The girl was very small.
"Hello there... I’m Kent. What’s your name?" Kent asked, looking down at the tiny girl.
"My name is Li Hua, Big brother," the small girl replied, staring up at Kent in an unusual way.
"Are you sure you’re old enough to sell on this busy street?" Kent couldn’t help but ask. Well, anyone meeting her for the first time would probably ask the same question.
"I am not that young, Big Brother; I’m just smaller than the average person," Li Hua said with a small smile.
"Smaller than the average person?" Kent muttered with a grin. "I’d say you’re much smaller than even the smallest of average people," he added, his smile widening.
"You don’t have to be rude," Li Hua pouted, clearly displeased by his comment about her size.
"Sorry about that," Kent laughed, amused by the small pout on her face.
"How much is a cake?" Kent decided to ask, changing the subject.
"One is 2 copper coins, but if you buy five, you get a discount of 2 copper coins," Li Hua replied, sounding like a seasoned businesswoman.
"Hmm... I don’t have copper coins on me. Do you mind taking this?" Kent said, retrieving eight spirit stones from his storage.
Li Hua’s eyes widened the moment she saw them. "Big Brother... this..."

In the kingdom, copper coins formed the basis of all currency. One hundred copper coins equaled one silver coin, and one hundred silver coins equaled one gold coin. However, the most valuable currency of all was the Spirit Stone, each worth an astonishing one hundred gold coins.
Seeing eight spirit stones in Kent’s hand, Li Hua was momentarily stunned, her mind going blank. The onlookers, observing their exchange, wore identical expressions of shock and awe.

"No need to be alarmed," Kent said casually. "I don’t have copper coins, so treat this as copper. That being said, I’ll be taking these ten cakes. See you around, Little Li Hua." He placed the spirit stones on her tray, packed the ten cakes into his space ring, and walked away.
Li Hua was frozen for a moment, but she quickly snapped out of her daze. She hurriedly tucked the spirit stones away from prying eyes and ran into the store she managed with her grandmother.
"What a small human. I have never met someone so small before," Kent muttered as he walked away from the store.
[That is because she is no ordinary human. That small mortal girl is someone with a very powerful heavenly constitution—the Atomic Divine Body.]
"What is that?" Kent muttered in response.

[The Atomic Divine Body is a rare constitution, most commonly awakened by a peculiar race, the dwarves. However, when awakened by them, it is almost a natural occurrence. Generally, dwarves who awaken such a physique are considered ordinary by many.]

However, when a different kind of species awakens this constitution, it blooms and becomes a heavenly treasure. In this case, this little human has a future that, even at my current level, I cannot calculate. Of course, she doesn’t know it yet. Nobody does.]
<What makes it a heavenly treasure?>

[All the most dangerous assassins you could ever meet—those who would come close to killing you—would either possess this kind of body or wish they did. Scratch that—if you ever meet an assassin with this body, run.]
<That serious, huh? I should become friends with this little girl before some sinister people set their sights on her,> Kent said.
[You should do that. But you should also be ready for anything, considering the moment her existence is discovered. You would be in trouble if she is somehow linked to you.]
<Don’t worry, Tower. I will become a Root Grandmaster soon, and then we can start making bold moves.>
Kent smiled, picturing the little girl. Once he was done with his business with the Alderford Family, he would come looking for her.
If only he knew they would be meeting sooner than he thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Manager Alina
paragraphs: "Esteemed customer, welcome back to my shop. How may I assist you today?" the store lady, Sofia, greeted Kent warmly as he entered the herb store.
"As we discussed last time, I would like to procure this ingredient," Kent replied, handing Sofia a long list.
"Wow, that’s quite the tall order today," Sofia said with a small smile. To her, the more, the merrier.
"Turn it," Kent said, his lips curling into a faint smile. Sofia flipped the list to reveal the ingredients for Tier 2 pills.
"Wow... This will take a few more hours than I initially thought," Sofia said, her smile broadening. She was clearly thrilled at the prospect of a lucrative sale.
"Take your time. That being said, how long will it take, and how much do I need to pay upfront this time?" Kent asked.
"It should take roughly seven to nine hours, and you’ll need to pay 20,000 spirit stones upfront. Tier 1 and Tier 2 ingredients are significantly more expensive."
"Here you go." Kent retrieved a small pouch containing the exact amount and handed it to her.
The tower was exceptionally useful. Not only did it list the required ingredients, but it also organized spirit stones swiftly and placed them in neat, convenient pouches for easy transactions.
"I will be back later for the goods. And hey, if you’re tired, you can take these two pills for an added energy boost," Kent said, placing two pill bottles on the counter before leaving.
Sofia, taken aback by his last sentence, picked up the first bottle and opened it. However, as soon as she saw what was inside, her eyes widened.
"This... a Perfect Tier 0 pill?" She almost dropped the bottle in shock when she discovered that the Body Strengthening Pill was 100% pure.

The second bottle, which contained a Stamina Recovery pill, was the same. The quality of the pills immediately blew her away. Not daring to let anyone discover what she’d just been gifted, she quickly tucked the pills away and closed the store.
Kent was using his senses to observe her reaction as he walked away toward the Silver Leaf Auction House, where he was scheduled to meet a certain manager who couldn’t wait to see him again.
Kent, of course, was eager to see her again. The last time he and Unity had been there, Manager Alina had clearly taken an interest in him, though she had been subtle about it.
But she wasn’t subtle enough. The Tower had picked up on her spying during his intimate moment with Unity. This piqued Kent’s curiosity, and he wanted to get to know her better.
Now that he was well-off, he could certainly use spirit stones to woo her, but that would take away from the fun of it. Plus, it wouldn’t be as secure as relying on his thrusting abilities.
With his divine rod hitting all the right spots, he was confident she would never betray him, even if she weren’t added to his harem.
For Kent, who sought to spread his fame far and wide, starting with someone who manages an auction house seems like a logical choice.
"It’s you," a guard said immediately as Kent appeared at the entrance of the auction house. He was one of the guards he had met the last time he was there.
"Yes, it’s me... any problem?" Kent asked.
"No... no problem at all," the guard began to sweat for some unknown reason.

"Then I will be on my way," Kent said before walking inside the auction house. Clearly, the guards had a hard time after the incident the last time. Although it may have appeared nobody witnessed it, Manager Alina somehow figured it out.
Now, since the other guards weren’t around, it could be said that he was fired for stopping Kent and Unity back then.
Immediately after Kent entered the auction house, he saw a certain lady with heavy hips walking toward him. He smiled slightly, his eyes watching her swaying waist as she approached him.
"Welcome to Silver Leaf Auction House, master... I mean Kent," Manager Alina said with a slight smile.
"Good to see you again, Alina," Kent said, also returning the smile.
"Do you have something for me today, too?" she asked.

"Indeed, but can we do it somewhere private?" Kent suggested, seeing that people were looking at them. Alina led the way, and soon, they were inside her office. Of course, Kent’s eyes never left her ass the whole way to her office.
"So what do you have for me today?" Alina asked, becoming much more easygoing around him now that they were alone.
Kent just smiled and retrieved over a hundred pill bottles containing 100% pure pills, placing them on the table. Alina was taken aback by the sheer number of pills he had brought out.
She quickly picked one and opened it. However, as soon as she did, her eyes widened, just like Sofia’s when she saw the purity of the pill.
"Are these all...?"
"Yes. They are all perfect, flawless pills," Kent said with a small smile.
"Unbelievable... To think that after thousands of years, a perfect pill has finally appeared in this auction house and in this kingdom at that," Alina muttered, clearly in disbelief.
"You don’t have to be shocked. I’m just getting started. This is just my way of telling you a new alchemist is in town," Kent said.
"This is too great. I have to inform the owner. She would love to know there is such a promising alchemist in town," Alina said, her eyes sparkling.
She was indeed very happy. After all, if she were the one to introduce Kent to the owner of Silver Leaf Auction House, she would be greatly rewarded.
An alchemist who can concoct perfect pills is something everyone would be shocked about. They would go to great lengths to form a connection with him, no matter what they had to do.
"Let’s settle our business first before adding anyone else," Kent smiled and leaned back in his seat.
"I’ll be right back," Alina said, running off to her inner office. Kent just looked at her heavy ass and smiled. He could already picture grabbing that ass as she bounced up and down.
A few minutes later, Alina returned with a list showing the selling price of the pills. It had been many years since they had bought a perfect pill, so she had to look hard for the price list.

"Although this list is outdated, it will help us calculate the right price for these pills," Alina said, making sure that no matter what, she would buy the pills and use them to gain favors that would spread her influence.

After all, in two months, they would be having their annual auction, and she wanted to be the auctioneer. Procuring dozens of perfect pills, even if they were just Tier 0, would undoubtedly secure her that spot.
If only she knew Kent had other plans.

"Well, you can take them for free. Since we are practically friends now, I figured I’d gift you these to start a very smooth and happy relationship that will benefit both of us in the coming days, weeks, and years," Kent said.
Alina froze in place, shocked.
