[Name: Kingdom Building Enchanted Book]
[Grade: Spiritual Grade]
[Type: Enchanted]
-- Long ago, the god of travelers sought to travel to a distant world.
However, he knew nothing of this world, and from what he knew, you can’t ask for direction when you get there.
Once you step in, you are on your own.
-- Nobody travels there.
But the god of travelers wanted to go.
So he sought out an enchantress, who he asked for a way to know everything about this world.
-- The enchantress created the [Kingdom Building Enchanted Book] and gave it to him.
This book will tell him everything he needs to know about this strange world.
In return, she asked for an unknown favor.
-- The God of Travelers readily accepted this unknown favor that was only made known when he bound with the book.
-- Till this day, the god of travelers never returned from his journey, and the enchantress never got the favor she asked for.
-- Nobody knew what this favor was and what happened to the god of travelers.
But one thing is certain: whoever dares to bind with this book will inherit this favor.
-- The enchantress has willed it.
[Does the master wish to form a soul contract with this book]

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Enchantress’s Favor
paragraphs: "This feels like a trap," Kent muttered, looking at the book.
He doesn’t need a prodigy to tell him this book is a trap, and he shouldn’t dare try to provoke it.
Of course, the book would allow him to know anything about any world he steps into, but the strange favor from the enchantress is not something he can handle.
A god hasn’t returned from this strange world; how much would he fare with his current strength? Daring to form a contract with this book is something he shouldn’t do.
Yet Kent doesn’t want to put it aside. He wants to bind the book with it and accept this strange favor. Who knows, he might just be able to do it.
But then again, what would happen the moment he forms the contract with the book? Would he be required to start the quest right away, or would he be given a grace period to increase his strength?
[Tower buddy, what should I do here?]
Kent asked his friend, the tower. So far, he has had to know the pros and cons, and since the tower is more knowledgeable than him, he can only rely on it.

[So far, the master doesn’t know anything about this world. And because I haven’t even awakened the first tier of my true power, I also lack the capabilities to know everything. This means the master can only trust blindly and hope he doesn’t fall where he is directed.

In that case, the book will come in handy, considering you will be able to learn everything there is to know about this world. The people, the races, the families, the organizations. You would know them all.
However, the cost is this unknown favor. But the question is, if a god was asked this favor, would the master be required to start immediately?]
"That is indeed a good question. The current me is but a bug compared to a god. Who knows what will happen when I bind with it?" Kent smiled.
"You are a genius, tower."
[I know, master, I am indeed a genius.]
Kent laughed and then decided to go ahead and form the contract.
Why?
Because he realized the favor does not require him to start now, no sane person would ask a kid who has yet to form his spiritual core to venture into an unknown world to complete a favor.
[The master can just drop his blood on the book to form the contract.]
Kent bit his finger and dropped a single drop of blood on the book. Immediately, it burst into a sparkle of golden light and entered his eyes, causing him to close them for a few minutes.
The moment he opened them, a radiant hue burst out of his eyes, sweeping through the entire Alderford mansion.
Everybody felt it, but it came and went like a flash, so nobody paid attention to it. That was especially true for Saintess Selene, who was tempted to go to Kent but stopped herself.
If she had, she would have seen Kent’s purple eyes become even cuter and more radiant than before. Just looking into his eyes would have excited her little sister.
Of course, that, too, lasted for a few moments before his eyes returned to normal. But one could tell something had changed in them.
Kent turn to the messages only to see one shocking thing after another.
[You have formed a contract with the Enchanted Book of Aether, the Enchantress of the Unknown]
[Your Appraisers Eye(Max) skill has merged with the Kingdom Building Enchanted Book. A mutation has been formed.]
[You have awakened a new skill: Enchanted Eyes]
[Skill Name: Enchanted Eyes]
[Grade: Divine]
[Rank: SSS+]
-- Your eyes have merged with the Kingdom Building Enchanted Book, granting you knowledge of everything there is to know about a town, City, Kingdom, and world.
-- You can now appraise any item, person, and spirit beasts to know more about them. Even hidden things can be revealed depending on your soul’s strength.
-- Your eyesight and awareness have been enhanced. You can now see through formations and enchantments.
-- To a certain extent, you can charm people and Spirit beasts.
-- You can see the true names of people and beasts that share destiny with you.
"Well, I guess since I am here, it meant I wouldn’t be starting the favor quest just yet." Kent smiles and then focuses on the rest of the messages.
[You have received the Attention of the Enchantress. Because you have bonded with the Enchanted book of Aether, the Enchantress has noticed you.]
[The Enchantress has deemed you worthy to carry out her unique Favor (Quest)]
[The Enchantress Favour]
[Type: Quest (Prologue)]
[Nature: Chain Quest (You must trigger the chain quest by completing the prologue quest)]
[Quest: Enchantress Favour]

-- Long ago, the Enchantress of Xggrial was attacked by a foe, and her heart was stolen. It was said this heart contains the Key of the Celestial Hidden Library. A library that is said to contain the knowledge of everything there is and is to come.

-- But perhaps knowing her heart would be stolen, she placed a curse on it, making it unusable to anyone. The curse that binds the heart also prevents her from leaving her temple, and no one can venture into her temple.
-- But many years ago, a god who specialized in travels managed to enter her temple and ask for a favor; in return, she also asked for a favor.
-- But alas, the god of travelers couldn’t accomplish his mission...Or maybe he did.
[You have received the Enchantress Favour and now have permission to enter her temple and receive her quest.]

[Because you are not qualified to begin the quest, the enchantress has granted you access to the Infinity Enchanted Quest Pool. You can now receive random quests and gain rewards from the enchantress.
Rewards that will help you grow faster.]
[Enchanted Quest Pool]
-- You can now receive quests whenever you want. Note that this quest will be based on your location and measured based on your cultivation talent, profession, and potential.
[Do you want to receive a Quest]
"Tower, I think we have hit a jackpot," Kent smiled, reading the messages.
A Mega chain quest and a Quest pool. That is indeed something worthy of having. He can now receive random quests, which, in this case, would reward him with things he can rely on to grow stronger.
[The master has indeed been blessed by the goddess of luck. That said, there is a message attached to the quest pool. The master might want to check that first.]
Kent focused his attention on the message. It was from the enchantress.
[Message from the Enchantress: Thank you for accepting my favor. Because of this, I will grant you three wishes. Just name them, and I will make them happen.]
A small smile appeared on his lips, which if the Enchantress were to see, her stolen heart would have skipped a bit.
Kent had always been fascinated by one thing: the three wishes of a Genie. He had always wanted to break those three wishes.
Of course, the rules prohibit one from wishing for three more wishes. But Kent, who had been thinking about this for years, knew everything rested in the sentences.
That is why, after today, the enchantress who had never taken an interest in anything would finally take an interest in Kent.
Kent formed his sentence and ensured everything was arranged perfectly before saying his first wish.
"For my first wish..."

chapters.title: Chapter 84: The Wish
paragraphs: "For my first wish, I wish for something that can transport me anywhere I want to go in the universe," Kent said, holding his breath.
While on Earth, he had spent many years learning about the nature of wishes.
He had watched countless movies that explored the concept of wishes and genies, and back then, he often fantasized about having the chance to make one himself.
Of course, his wish at the time was simple: to be able to use his dick fully and experience pleasure. However, that was just a fairytale in his mind back then.
Now, things were different. He was no longer in a world where cultivation was impossible, and the chance to make real wishes was finally within his grasp.
His goal was to break the system of wishes.

Many would wish for riches, charm, or revenge, but he wanted something he could use forever. Of course, this wish was intended to help him visit the god realm—specifically, the Realm of Hatred and Resentment.
He wanted to find a way to meet Vexthra, his first wife and the goddess who had transmigrated him to this new world and given him everything he now had.

Although he could speak to her every 100 days for five minutes, he needed a way to see her, even if only for a day or an hour. He had no desire to venture recklessly into the god realm, where he could be obliterated at any moment.
He only wanted to see Vexthra, with whom he hoped to spend time occasionally.
[Your wish has been accepted by the Enchantress. The following solutions have been provided. You must choose one of these three solutions]
1. Astral Nexus Orb

-- A cosmic crystal that allows dimensional travels. When infused with spirit stones and soul essence, the orb creates a shimmering portal capable of transporting the user to any location in the universe.
Activation Requirements:
- Spirit Stones: 500,000,000 (Max)
- Soul Essence: 50,000 (Max)
Cooldown Time:
- Once requirements are met, the orb needs 72 hours to activate.
- Once used, the orb goes into a 60-day cooldown.
Limitations:
- Each use allows for one round trip or up to 24 hours at the destination before forcibly returning the user to their original location.
- You cannot return anything from your return trip if you go to realms higher than yours.
2. Cosmic Talisman of Passage
-- An ancient talisman etched with celestial runes. The talisman forms a temporary "spirit tether," allowing the user to phase to their desired destination.
Activation Requirements:
- Spirit Stones: 900,000,000 (Max)
- Soul Essence: 70,000 (Max)
Cooldown Time:
- Once requirements are met, the orb needs 48 hours to activate.
- Once used, the orb goes into a 60-day cooldown.
Limitations:
- The talisman only works within the same dimensional plane unless triple the activation cost is paid.
- You will be forcefully returned back after 48 hours.
- You cannot return anything from your return trip if you go to realms higher than yours.
3. Starbound Compass
-- A mystical compass with a needle made of stardust, pointing unerringly toward the desired destination when activated. The compass projects a portal for travel.
Activation Requirements:
- Spirit Stones: 10,000,000,000 (Max)
- Soul Essence: 100,000 (Max)
Cooldown Time:
- Once requirements are met, the orb needs 96 hours to activate.
- Once used, the orb goes into a 60-day cooldown.
Limitations:
- You will be forcefully returned after 72 hours.
- The portal can be closed using the portal, but if the user doesn’t return within 72 hours, they will be forcefully pulled back.
- The user can return any item provided they can be stored in their soul. Space rings are not allowed.
[Note: Before using any of the three items, you must know where you want to go.]
"All these options are good. Tower, which one should I choose?" Kent asked. All three options were good and could allow him to visit Vexthra, but there were limitations.
[The master can choose any of the three options, but I prefer the third option. The reason is simple: the third option allows the master to bring back any item of choice.
Of course, storing something inside your soul while you haven’t awakened your soul sea is impossible.
But the master has Tower storage, something that is akin to soul storage. This means you can bring back any item of your choice.
Of course, the cost is huge, but the master has the soul bead, which can power the compass five times.
Once I am awakened, we can tweak it to add more time. But comparing the price to the chance for the master to see the Goddess, I would advise the master to pick the third option.]
"Then I choose the third option," Kent said with a smile.
Immediately after he gave the order, a small compass appeared in his hands. As soon as he touched it, he could feel the power brewing within it.
[Message from the Enchantress: You have used one of your three wishes. If you ever want to make a wish, just tap into the connection that has formed between us and say your wish.
Also, you have to visit the world of Xggrial once you ascend to the High realm to receive your quest. Good luck, and may the goddess of quests and adventures bless your journey.]
"Good to know I have to rise to a high world first before the quest begins," Kent said with a smile. This is indeed great.
He only wanted a book to learn about the kingdom, but in the end, he received skills, three wishes, and a way to travel the Universe.
Additionally, he now had access to the Quest Pool, where, with just a thought, he could receive a random quest. Now, that was something that could make him stronger much faster.
"I need to get my affairs in order so I can go visit my goddess. Ha, with 72 hours on my hands, I’m going to make her cry tears of pleasure," Kent said with a sly smile.
[Master, this compass is much more complex than we think. It will require some time to study it, but I believe the portal part of it is just the tip of the iceberg.]
"Let me appraise it." Kent activated his enchanted eye, appraising the compass.
[Item Name: Starbound Compass]
[Grade: Supreme]
-- The lost compass of the ancient travelers of Gxxyla.
-- It is said that the ancient travelers of Gxxyla were beings who traversed the entire universe and beyond.
-- But many years ago, rumors arose that their guide, who had led them through the cosmos, had gone missing after a terrible battle with the creatures of the unknown, the Hylians.
-- For many years, the compass has wandered the cosmos, seeking a worthy ???
"Ouch," Kent cried in pain.
A head-splitting and soul-shattering ache surged through his head and soul as he read the details of the appraisal. Beads of sweat formed on his forehead.
[The master still doesn’t have enough soul and mental strength to appraise a supreme item.]
"I see. I guess I’ll hold back the appraisal for now. Once I become strong enough, I’ll try again." Kent placed the compass back in the Tower storage so it could continue analyzing it.
He could tell the item was not something simple from the small portion he had managed to read.
"Tower, let’s continue with the rest."

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Skills Upgraded
paragraphs: [You have successfully completed a quest. Quest Name: Guardian’s Protect]
[Rewards: 4 Skill Upgrade Passes | The Rat’s Lair Medallion | A Hidden Reward]
"Tower, how do the Skill Upgrade Passes work?"

[The Skill Upgrade Passes can be used to upgrade the grade of your skills. Basically, instead of upgrading the ranks, which only enhances the effect, the grade upgrade will evolve the skill to the next level.]

"I see. This is good, then." Kent wasn’t really concerned with the reward he would earn when he received the quest. His mind was on rescuing Li Hua. However, now that he had received such a reward, he could only smile.
"Although I have four passes, I must select between the three skills now lagging behind since the Appraiser’s Eye skill has evolved to Enchanted Eyes."
Since the Appraiser’s Eye has now become a divine skill, Kent only needs to select between [Elemental Manipulation], [36 String Weaving Strike], and [Teleport].
Of course, he could use them to develop his divine skills, but that would be a waste, considering he doesn’t have the strength to wield even 10% of those skills yet.
That is especially true for martial skills. Making them Ancient-grade skills would be good, but they would remain as trophies until he can wield them—which he is nowhere near doing.
Now, which of the three skills will receive a double upgrade? He has four upgrade passes, and with his skill set, he doesn’t need new sword skills. He can make do with the ones he has.
But even if he wants more, he still has two slots he can use to receive two skills from Vexthra’s arsenal and one from Lilian. He doesn’t really need a new martial skill.
However, if he were to upgrade these three, he would gain some really cool upgrades. Of course, with him having no control over how the skill evolves, he can only cross his fingers and hope.
"Tower, use one pass on the 36 String Weaving Strike," Kent decided. The outcome will determine what he gets.
[Command received. Upgrading skill... 36 String Weaving Strike skill successfully upgraded from Earth Grade to Heaven Grade.]
[The skill has undergone a name change; 72 String Sovereign Strike]
[Skill Name: 72 String Sovereign Strike]
[Grade: Heaven]
[Rank: SS]
-- Using 72 strings fashioned from sword qi, unleash any pattern you can visualize with a single swing of your sword.
-- Based on your mastery and mental strength, the patterns can be manipulated mid-attack to counter enemy defenses

"I will bake banana cakes for you, Mother," Li Hua said, happy to have such a beautiful woman as her mother.
Why?
Her grandma always told her that beautiful women were rich, and while Kent didn’t know it yet, Li Hua was all about money.
She was the one who had forced her grandma to start selling cakes in the city.
She managed their accounts and assigned expenditures after every sale.
She loved handling money, and having such a beautiful mother could only mean one thing: more money.
Of course, Saintess Selene wasn’t thrilled about the idea of becoming a mother so suddenly, but when Li Hua spoke, she felt an unexpected calm wash over her chest.
However, she still needed to get used to it.
Yet, with the little human clinging to her neck, she could only sigh and hope Li Hua wouldn’t stick to her forever.
If only she knew that Li Hua had already accepted her as her mother in her heart and would do anything to remain her daughter.
"I will compensate you later, Master.
You must take care of this little human and ensure she doesn’t feel out of place.
I know you are the best so I won’t have to worry too much.
That said, I will be going to the city with my ladies to buy some skills and weapons.
You should come with us," Kent said.
"Okay," Saintess Selene said, accepting the invite.
They wouldn’t sit idle now that Kent had angered the Ashland Noble Family.
Kent smiled and walked away, leaving the new Mother to talk with her daughter.
"Mother, you are very beautiful," Li Hua said, brushing her hands on Saintess Selene’s cheeks.
"You are also beautiful," Selene replied to her.
"I am just tiny, don’t lie to me, Mother." She pouted as she said that.
Saintess Selene smiled, knowing what she said was true.
However, while she may be tiny, she is also cute.
She looks like an adorable little loli.
"Don’t worry about your size.
What matters is that you are tiny and cute.
I doubt anyone will look down on you when you come of age."
"You think so?" Li Hua smiled.
"Yes.
I will ensure you become an adorable lady when you come of age.
Even if you remain tiny, you will still look cute." For some reason, Saintess Selene had started to like the idea of having a daughter, and a unique one at that.
"Mother, do you use the sword to fight bad guys?
My Grandmaster has tiny knives for battle," Li Hua asked.
While she didn’t know her grandma was a Spirit Beast all along, she was aware her grandma was a fighter who used knives for battles.
She had wanted to learn more, but her grandma told her she must first turn 15.
"Do you want to learn how to use the sword?" Saintess Selene asked with an expectant smile.
"I want to learn, but my Grandma gave me this.
She said I can learn to use it when I become a cultivator."
Li Hua took a space ring that had been tied inside her clothes and retrieved a small box.
Inside the box, a pair of dark daggers could be seen.
They are black and sleek.
Saintess Selene’s eyes widened when she saw the grade of the daggers.
’These are Spirit-grade weapons.
They are soul weapons,’ she thought, visibly shocked that both daggers are of the spirit grade.
Soul Weapons.
Weapons that grow with their master.
"Li Hua, do you want me to hold on to these daggers for you?" she asked.
Li Hua, who had been paying attention to her mother’s expression, smiled and handed her the box containing the daggers.
"I will leave them in your care, Mother.
But still, I want to learn how to use the sword from you."
Right now, Li Hua was after her mother’s money to open her cake business.
This meant she had to do things that would bring her closer to her mother.
Once she got close enough, she would strike, and soon, every last copper coin ever owned by Saintess Selene would be hers to manage.

chapters.title: Chapter 90: The Art Of Scheming
paragraphs: "Repeat what you just said," Daisy Ashland commanded, addressing a young man who was on all fours on the ground. He was one of their spies and informants.
"My Lady, my Lord, the guards sent to Mokasa Prison are all dead, and the package has been taken away," the man said, praying Dave Ashland wouldn’t lose his temper and kill him.
Three days ago, when Daisy received news of Kent looking for Li Hua, she devised a plan she believed to be foolproof. The plan was perfect, but she failed to account for Kent’s strength.
It seemed she didn’t know Kent’s true power, and so she and the guards underestimated him. But the outcome had already been determined three days ago.

They just received this report because they never expected their side to lose. For the past two days, they had waited for updates. However, even after 48 hours with no say from the prison, they sent one of their spies.
The information they were now receiving caused Dave Ashland’s aura to fill the room. The spy would have long suffocated had he not being a Root Saint at the 7th level.
"What happened?" Daisy asked.
"It seems they fought whoever came for the package, and they all died. The only thing I saw was headless bodies," the spy replied immediately.
"How many dead bodies did you count?" Daisy asked again. Unlike Dave, she maintained a clear mind despite the nagging feeling of unease striking her like a hidden attack.
"I counted 171 bodies, my lady," the spy replied.
"Is that all?" Daisy asked, expecting more.
"Yes. I saw this mask beside one of the bodies," the spy said, taking out a black mask. The moment Daisy saw the mask, her expression darkened for a moment before brightening again.
"Hand it over."
The spy obeyed and gave her the mask.
"You may leave. You have done well."
The spy wasted no time and disappeared from sight. The pressure in the room was too much for him to endure.
It was only after he left that Dave stopped exerting his aura. Unlike Daisy, who remained relatively calm, he was more agitated and angry about the unexpected events that had happened lately.
"Hahaha!" Daisy burst into resounding laughter as she appraised the mask in her hand.
"What is it, Daisy?" Dave asked, looking at his wife strangely.
"Nothing much. However, I think the dark-robed lady has been killed, and this is proof. Do you know what this means?"
"Enlighten me, dear." Dave was clueless. Unlike the scheming Daisy, He didn’t have a good head on his shoulders.
Thankfully, he had Daisy to rely on.

"This mask belonged to the Lady from the Dark Devil Church. This means she is dead, and we are free of her. It also means we can move ahead and contact the church on our own volition. But that’s not even the best part," Daisy said, a smile forming as she watched the lost look on Dave’s face.

"Since the Alchemist and his master won’t be able to challenge us directly, since doing so would go against the kingdom. It means we have some time on our hands. They can’t do anything for now despite his master being a Sword Saintess.
Even if he wants to act, he wouldn’t be able to target us directly. Instead of attacking us outright, he’ll continue to bide his time, waiting to find something that can destroy our reputation.
But, of course, we all know they won’t. Even though they caught our spy, she wouldn’t say anything. And even if she does, it’s not like she knows anything critical.
The Alchemist and his master, along with the Alderford family, cannot do anything to us. But we have an opportunity to strike at them using foreign forces.
With this mask, we can pit the Dark Devil Church against that brat and let them handle him. We shouldn’t strike directly—it would only result in senseless deaths.
We’ll let the Dark Devil Church take care of things from here. I know for a fact that even with a Peak Root Sage guarding him, he wouldn’t survive against the Church.
We might lose the Atomic Divine Body, but fostering a good relationship with the Church will benefit us far more in the long run."
"That is genius. With this, we can strike three birds with one stone. But the question is, how sure are we that they haven’t discovered anything from Olive?" Dave asked.
Olive, the spy they had planted inside the Alderford Family, was one of his concubines. He was using her to gather intel, but Kent exposed her. She was a weak point on their part.

"That is because the Honey Bastard John is in love with her, and I doubt he will torture her for information. He might kill her to cover his own affairs and mistakes. But even if he doesn’t care about her too much, Olive only knows up to the Spirit Root incident.

And it’s not like many know about the Makosa prison and its ties to us. So, if anything, they will be expecting us to do something that proves we are in cahoots with the Makosa prison and the kidnapping of the Atomic Divine Body."
"I see. This is good then. Although the bitch betrayed me by sleeping with another man, she has served her purpose." Dave looked mad, but he had to compromise.
"What should we do now?" Daisy asked.
"Right now, we keep our distance from the Alderford Family and make sure we don’t do anything stupid to give them a reason to link the recent events to us.
Since they can’t outright challenge us to a war, we can only wait for the heat to die down. It will be best to target only that brat and forget about the Alderford Family.
I will also contact our secret army to make their way here in the next few days. Since they don’t have any evidence yet, we can only be on guard and wait for anything to happen."
"What about the Dark Devil Church?" Dave asked.
"They will come. I am sure they know of our connection to that bitch, so they will come. When they do, we just have to throw everything onto the Saintess and her disciple."
"That is smart, sweetheart," Dave said, smiling. He had accepted the fact that soon, he would become the king of the land and rule with an iron fist while claiming all the ladies for himself.
He was in full support of Daisy’s schemes.
"I will order my men to go clear the prison to get rid of the evidence," Dave said, standing up.
"No. Go there personally and make sure you chop the lady into chunks. Just make sure she is recognizable, but violate her body.
We need something that will make the Dark Devil Church tick. Finding the body of their fellow member violated that way will make them very mad.
We need them mad to take care of our foes. So do it well. No... take me with you. I want to be there to instruct you on what to do and what not to do."
Soon, the scheming wife and husband left to create a trap that will make some people very mad in the coming days.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: The Church Is Angry
paragraphs: Vastport City is the capital of the Althea Kingdom. It’s a hub known for large-scale trade, auctions, sales, and pleasure. If you’re looking for a place that offers it all, then Vastport City is the destination.

The Althea Legacy family is the ruling family of the entire kingdom, and Vastport serves as their familial stronghold. They hold dominion there, and their prosperity has extended its blessings to other businesses and factions.
Life is good in Vastport, and businesses strive to meet its high standards. But, as with everything good, there is a darker side—the Dark Devil Church also maintains a presence there.
The Dark Devil Church branch in the Althea Kingdom is located 45 miles away from Vastport City, nestled within the Jkic Mountains.
Currently, three people are on their knees, sweating buckets. They are all wearing masks, but their sweat can be seen streaming down their faces.
Another masked figure sits on a dark, throne-like chair.
Behind him stand three individuals who, even when they were observed with the naked eye, seem to possess no presence at all.
"What did you just say?" the masked man asked, his voice icy cold.
"My Lord, the life crystal belonging to Lady Sandra cracked three days ago," one of the three men on their knees answered, shaking like a massage chair.
"How?" The masked leader seemed to lose all rationale upon hearing this. He had just returned from a successful trip, only to be greeted with news he wasn’t prepared for.

"Lady Sandra said she was going to meet some business acquaintances, as you already knew, a week ago. However, six days ago, she messaged us and mentioned that she had chanced upon an atomic divine body, which you were also aware of.
But that was all she told us. A few days ago, we discovered her life crystal had cracked. We tried contacting her, but there was no response."

A life crystal is an enchanted artifact that holds a fragment of one’s life force. As long as the individual is alive, the crystal continues to glow. However, the moment they die, it cracks or shatters.
Secret organizations like this one commonly use such crystals to monitor their members. Even most royals use them to ensure their prince and princesses are safe and thriving beyond palace walls.
Hearing that Lady Sandra’s life crystal had cracked could only mean one thing: she was dead, and there was no mistaking that.
"Did she leave a name for who these business partners were?" the lord asked.
"Yes. She was meeting with the Ashland Noble Family, the nobles of Caprath City, to discuss a potential Platinum-grade spirit root that had surfaced in the Alderford Merchant family.

However, her last message stated that she had discovered an atomic divine body and, along with the Ashland Noble Family, was working to secure it. That was all until her life crystal cracked a few days ago.

"I see. I want you three, along with these three, to go and investigate. If you find any foul play, use any means necessary to get answers. We don’t have much time, and the leader is expecting good results from us," the lord commanded.
"My Lord, are we authorized to use any means at all for this mission? Lady Sandra was one of us, and if we do uncover foul play, can we go as far as total annihilation?" one of the three asked.

"Yes," the lord replied. "Just make sure it doesn’t trace back to us. Also, ensure you locate the Atomic Divine Body at all costs. If necessary, eliminate anyone who knew of it and, if possible, erase their entire bloodline."
The three on the ground and the three behind him left. They were Dark Assassins, mindless drones created by the foul experiments of the Dark Devil Church to work for them.
Over the years, they conducted many vile experiments just to create creatures and people with unique traits to carry out their deeds. Right now, the Dark Assassins are their best creation yet.
Sending them on a mission could only mean one thing: total annihilation.
The Lord who was left in the room removed his mask, revealing the face of a handsome middle-aged man. He sat there for a few minutes without saying much.
"Ashland and Alderford, how unfortunate you chose to enter my grip. Since that is the case, I must make sure you learn from your mistakes."
Soon, he, too, was gone from the room. The Church is angry, and blood will spill soon.
Fisher’s Haven is a fishing city responsible for all the sea spirit beast meat that one would drool over. All businesses there are linked to the sea, and that’s what most thrive on.
This city is the closest to Caprath City and is the easiest route to leave Althea’s Kingdom. It has large ships that can take you anywhere on the human continent and beyond.
Currently, two cloaked figures were moving under the cover of night, heading toward this city. It didn’t take a genius to see they were sneaking around.
They stopped at the border separating Caprath City and Fisher’s Haven a few hours later.

"This is as far as I can take you. Take this pouch; it contains 30,000 spirit stones and some things you might need to leave the kingdom. Once things settle down, I will come find you," one of the cloaked figures said calmly.
The other cloaked figure removed her hood, revealing a beautiful face.
"Thank you, John. I promise I will pay you back," the lady said.
If Kent were around, he would recognize her as Lady Olive, the spy he caught. She moved closer and planted a kiss on the other cloaked figure’s lips.
She was the spy the Ashland Noble Family sent to infiltrate the Alderford Merchant Family.
The other cloaked figure was John Alderford, the head of the Alderford Merchant Family. The one who was supposed to interrogate and dispose of her.
"You don’t have to. This is all because of that brat. If he had left right after his job was done, none of this would have happened. But don’t worry, I’ll make sure there’s no next time."

The two kissed for a few more minutes before Lady Olive crossed the border. John stayed behind for a while, his expression heavy with sadness, before returning to his family—the same family he had betrayed by setting a very dangerous person free.
Lady Olive traveled many miles into Fisher’s Haven before stopping. She turned back to face Caprath City.
"Oh, John, you should have listened to the brat and your bitch Cynthia by killing me. While I know you love me, I can’t say the same. Ah well, this was a mission, and I succeeded."
Lady Olive retrieved two medallions from thin air and muttered an incantation. Moments later, the medallions burst into a cascade of shimmering light and vanished into the void.
"My work here is done," she said, her voice cold and final. With that, she transformed into a dark crow and soared into the night, leaving behind one chilling prophecy:

"When twilight embraces the moon, the heavens shall rend asunder, and they will descend. Their vengeance will scorch the world, their fury shall drown the skies, and the frail worms who scorned the stars will tremble as the mighty fall."

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Green Gate Bazaar
paragraphs: "The last time I saw you two, you were a Level 4 Root Master and a Level 9 Root Master. When did you ladies become this powerful?" Saintess Selene asked as they sat in Uncle Drew’s carriage and began heading to the city for their shopping.
She was dumbfounded when she saw Unity and Lilian’s cultivation bases. Unity was now a Level 7 Root Master, and Lilian a Level 4 Root Grandmaster—and that was less than a month ago.
"You know what, I don’t want to know. This monster here has already broken the rules of cultivation." She just shook her head and went back to playing with Li Hua, who was sticking to her like glue.
Li Hua was shocked when she saw Unity and Lilian join them for the outing. It was her first time seeing them, but after Kent introduced them, she instantly accepted them.
Inwardly, though, she was very happy that two more beautiful ladies had joined her inner circle. This meant she had more avenues to extort money from.
Her love for money started to soar.

Saintess Selene’s mind was in turmoil. The first time she met Kent, he was at the Root Blossom stage, yet somehow, in less than a month, he broke through to the Root Ascendant stage, and then he entered the Root Master stage and the Level 7 stage too.

Comparing him to the two ladies seemed like a stupid thing to do. But since her cultivation base was higher, she could tell the foundation the two ladies now had was several times firmer than when she met them a few weeks ago.
’Just what is he feeding them?’ She focused her attention on Kent, who was sitting with Uncle Drew as they entered the city.
’Whatever you are feeding them, I will find out soon enough,’ she said inwardly.
Meanwhile, Kent, who was being plotted against by his beautiful master, began acquiring admirers as they entered the city with the carriage this time.
"Uncle Drew, why aren’t you parking like you used to?" Kent asked.
"I have obtained my license, so I can now move through the city with my carriage. The young master doesn’t have to worry about walking in these busy streets," Uncle Drew replied with a smug smile.
"Congratulations, I guess," Kent said with a smile, already contemplating whether to add him to the servant tower.
’I will learn more about him later before adding him to the tower,’ he thought.
"Then where are we going? I only said I want to go to the best place to buy cultivation resources," Kent asked as they moved through the busy streets, where other carriages could also be seen moving.
"We are going to the Green Gate Bazaar. Aside from a major auction, the Green Gate Bazaar is the best place to buy anything you want.
It’s the best place, from alchemy equipment to weapons, skill books, and whatnot. However, it’s also a very expensive place to shop from, but since the young master wants the best, I picked it."
"I see. Thank you. Tell me when we get there," Kent said before entering the carriage room.
Thirty minutes later, they arrived in front of a tall tower that seemed to have seven levels, crowned with a colossal green gate. One glance was enough to tell you it was the Green Gate Bazaar.
"Young Master, we are here," Uncle Drew said, stopping in front of the Bazaar building.
Kent and the ladies alighted. When his eyes landed on the green gate, he appraised it with his new and improved Enchanted Eyes.
[Green Gate Bazaar]
-- The Green Gate Bazaar is one of the main hubs for buying and selling rare goods and services. Inside the bazaar are various stores belonging to some of the finest businesses in the kingdom.

-- It has seven floors, each increasing the grade of items available for purchase. The first three floors offer Earth-grade items, the fourth to sixth floors feature Heaven-grade treasures, and the final floor holds Legendary-grade items.
-- Only Spirit Stones can be used here, and anyone caught cheating will be banned for 100 years or, in some cases, permanently.
-- All items purchased are non-refundable.
-- You don’t need qualifications to enter any floor. All you have to do is pay the appropriate amount, and you will be teleported inside.
"This place looks better than I had hoped," Kent muttered, already eyeing the top floor.
"Can we really buy from here? I heard things here are very expensive," Lilian said, frowning as she gazed at the towering structure.
"Don’t worry about that. You should focus on the skills and techniques you’ll need. As for the money, leave that to me." Kent turned and looked at the ladies accompanying him.
"All of you should only worry about what to buy. I’ll pay, even if it costs a million Spirit Stones," he smirked. "Even though I dislike bragging, I am very rich."
As if to prove his point to the ladies, who were giving him skeptical looks, Kent retrieved 50,000 Spirit Stones and handed them to Uncle Drew.
"You can go look around and buy whatever you want." Uncle Drew accepted the stones with a pleased smile.
"Let’s go." Before the ladies could protest, Kent beckoned them to follow him inside. Li Hua glanced at Uncle Drew, eyeing the Spirit Stones in his hand for a few seconds before turning away.

Her attention shifted from the group of ladies to Kent. Soon, she resolved that she would secure a place as his treasurer. After all, anyone who could casually hand over that many Spirit Stones to a mere carriage driver must possess extraordinary wealth.
’Grandma, look, I just found a rich brother. You can rest well now,’ Li Hua said inwardly as she held onto Saintess Selene’s hand.
"Welcome to the Green Gate Bazaar," a guard at the entrance announced as Kent’s group arrived before the grand gates.
"Please, we would like to go to the last floor," Kent said confidently.

Unity, Lilian, and Saintess Selene gave him skeptical looks. While Saintess Selene may hold a high rank, her authority meant nothing here. The bazaar was strictly for business, and everyone had to pay.
The guard gave Kent an appraising look as if trying to determine whether he was serious or simply wasting his time. After a few moments, he decided to state the cost.
"That will be 250,000 Spirit Stones. Each of you is required to pay 50,000," the guard said.

"Here you go," Kent said, handing over a pouch filled with Spirit Stones, leaving the guard dumbfounded. Normally, only the wealthy and influential dared to enter the top floor, and even then, it was rare for more than one person to pay such an exorbitant fee.
But Kent had just paid for five people without so much as batting an eye. If that wasn’t shocking enough, the casual manner in which he did it certainly was.
While the three ladies wore expressions of astonishment, Li Hua moved closer to Kent and tugged at his sleeve.
"Big brother, after we return, I have some business ideas I’d like to discuss with you," Li Hua said, her voice sweet and innocent.
Kent nodded, and Li Hua smiled, shaking her head inwardly.
"We’ve paid. Can we go now?" Kent snapped his fingers, jolting the guard from his stupor.

The guard nodded quickly and placed a card on a small platform. A spell circle appeared beneath the group, and within moments, they vanished, reappearing on the seventh floor where the finest treasures awaited.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Shopping at the 7th Floor (1)
paragraphs: Immediately after Kent and the ladies appeared on the 7th floor, many stores greeted them, each selling various items. Strangely, only a few people could be seen moving from store to store, browsing through the mouth-watering goods.
Because of this, Kent’s group immediately attracted some attention. That was especially true for Saintess Selene, whom people immediately started to recognize.
But Kent ignored them all and turned to the ladies.
"Unity, since you picked the bow, you’ll need to find one you want to wield along with some skills you want for now. Don’t worry. Because of your unique situation, we can stop at two skills.
Don’t worry, I’ll make sure nobody cheats you."

Kent turned to Lilian. "I know you can cast up to a Tier 3 spell circle, so aim for at least three since, for now, your unique situation won’t help you much in that regard. You can pick two for each element.
Also, you can go for a good wand if you want."

He then turned back to his Master. Saintess Selene was looking at him strangely. For some reason, she felt like spending Kent’s money as if it were her own. But a part keeps telling her not to fall for it.
"As for you, Master, you can pick any number of sword skills you want and any armor if you want. I’ll do well to spend on you. Call it an investment for the future."
"An investment for the future?" Saintess Selene squinted her eyes at him.
"Don’t worry about it. You’ll understand soon enough," Kent said, giving her a wink before gesturing for them to head toward a store inside the bazaar that seemed to sell only skill books.
Saintess Selene calmed herself by convincing herself this was good.

’He is my disciple, and it’s only natural for me to spend his money. And since he is offering, I might as well accept the offer. The more skills I have, the higher my chances of protecting him,’ she reasoned.
After settling her thoughts, she followed the Dragon and his women as they made their way to the Happy Day Skill Books Store.
"Welcome to Happy Day Skill Books Store. How may I help these esteemed customers?" the store attendant greeted them warmly.
"We are looking to buy some spells and techniques. I hope you don’t mind if we browse around," Kent replied, and the attendant gestured for them to enter.
Many skill books were neatly placed in cases around the shelves to preserve their quality. To many, these books were treasures worth going to hell and back for.
The reason was simple. Legendary-grade skills are at the top of the food chain.
Take Lilian, for example. She is a mage who specializes in Ice and Water spells. She could cast spells up to three spell circles. These circles determined one’s proficiency in the craft.
If she managed to cast a Legendary-grade spell using all three spell circles, then, despite being just a Root Grandmaster, she would be able to fight a Peak Root Saint regardless of the situation.

In this world, Legendary-grade skills sat at the pinnacle. They represented the limit one could obtain. Of course, rumors persisted that royal families held Mystical-grade skills, but for now, the furthest the rich and powerful could aspire to was Legendary.
If someone like Lilian were to invoke a Legendary-grade spell with her Tier 3 spell circles, the chances of her going toe-to-toe with a Peak Root Saint were over 70%.
This meant that if Kent was generous enough to give them the chance to wield Legendary-grade spells and techniques, their destinies were on the cusp of a monumental shift.

Even Saintess Selene couldn’t deny the allure of acquiring two or three Legendary-grade sword skills. The highest skill she currently possessed was Heaven-grade, which shaped her into who she is today.

She deeply desired a Legendary-grade sword skill, so she unknowingly fell into Kent’s first trap. Soon, she would learn that these Legendary-grade techniques were only a ploy from her cunning disciple in other to get into her pants.
"I won’t want to waste your time, sir, so why don’t you bring us to the section where the Legendary-grade items are?" Kent said, looking around. All the skills there were Heaven-grade skills.
Of course, no sane person would hang dozens of Legendary-grade skills loose for just anyone to see.

The attendant looked at Kent briefly before shifting to Saintess Selene. Seeing she was with him, he gestured for them to follow. Soon, they entered a new room where 24 skills could be seen in jade cases.

"These are currently the only Legendary-grade skill books we have. I hope you find what you want since Legendary-grade skills are particularly rare," the attendant said before making way for them to look around.
"Ladies, look around," Kent said, making way for Lilian, Unity, and Saintess Selene to walk toward the jade cases to examine.
’Tower, look through all the skills and find something I might want to have in my arsenal. Soul-type skills will be best.’
[Way ahead of you, Master.]

Kent, at the moment, doesn’t have to worry about sword-type skills. He already had the [Annihilation Sword Art], [Nine Calamities Sword Strike], [72 String Sovereign Strike], and the [Elemental Lord] skill.
He didn’t need any sword skills at the moment. However, since he has now started as a Soul Master, he could at least look for something to focus on using his soul strength.
Twenty minutes later, Unity walked forward with two jade cases. Lilian came with one, and Saintess Selene also brought one.
Kent didn’t comment on their choices since he knew they had already consulted their big sister, who was far more knowledgeable than him.
She was a goddess, after all.
"What about you, Unity? Which ones did you pick?" Kent asked. Lilian had two skill books that used the bow and the lightning element.

Unity held up the two jade cases and smiled. "The first one is [Thunder God’s Precision]. It’s a bow skill that uses lightning to enhance speed and accuracy making every lightning arrow many times deadly."
She placed it down gently before lifting the second case. "And this one is [Heaven’s Arrowstorm]. It lets me shoot thousands of energy arrows at once. Perfect for crowd control."
She looked at Kent with a hint of pride. "I think these will suit me well."
"It seems you love them. So you can have both," Kent said, and the store attendant raised an eyebrow.
’Who is this young man?’ he thought inwardly.
"What about you, Lilian? What spell did you pick?" Kent asked, turning his attention to her.
Lilian held up the jade case and smiled. "I chose ’Frostfire Twin Dragons.’ It lets me summon an ice dragon and a fire dragon at the same time."

She glanced at the jade case, her excitement showing. "The two dragons can combine their powers for stronger attacks or fight separately to handle different enemies. I think it suits my style perfectly."
"Two in one, huh? Not bad," Kent said with a nod, then turned to Saintess Selene.
"What about you, Master? What sword skill did you get?" he asked, his tone curious.
Saintess Selene held up her jade case with a cute smile. "Celestial Blade Dance. It’s a skill that allows me to summon dozens of ethereal swords to attack and defend simultaneously."
"The skill also enhances my sword intent, making each strike faster and sharper. I think this one is enough." One could see she was very happy with the skill in hand.
"We will take these four skills," Kent turns to the store owner.
[Master, I think your Master wants another skill, but she doesn’t want to bankrupt you]
The tower suddenly prompted him.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Shopping at the 7th Floor (2)
paragraphs: Kent didn’t immediately do anything. He only focused on knowing the price of the ones they had picked. While his wealth was in the trillions, he also wanted to use the chance to make subtle moves toward getting what he wanted.
Right now, Saintess Selene was in his sights. Although she wouldn’t give in just yet, Kent and the Tower concluded that he should take the path of the sword.
The lady was obsessed with the sword, so if he was going to get inside her pants, he would first have to crush her in the sword’s path.
Luckily for him, while he couldn’t crush her in a duel, he could do it with his wealth. If she saw a skill she wanted but didn’t want to look too needy, he would find a way to make her appear needy.
’Being rich sure has its perks,’ Kent said inwardly while waiting for the store attendant to tell him the price of the four skill books.

"The Thunder God’s Precision is 40,000,000, the Heaven’s Arrowstorm is 50,000,000, while both the Frostfire Twin Dragons and Celestial Blade Dance are 30,000,000 each. The total will be 150,000,000 spirit stones," the store attendant said excitedly.
Who knew how much profit he would make if he managed to sell four legendary-grade items?
[The price, although slightly exaggerated, is still within the acceptable ranges.]

The tower, which Kent was tasked with using to track the prices of the books, said to Kent, making him nod. He then walked toward another legendary grade skills line on the shelf and took a case containing a sword skill called Void Cutter.
[Master, you do know you can use the Sword Mind technique to learn the skills without paying for them, right?] The tower said, making Kent nearly trip.
’We don’t have to be stingy, Tower. There will come a time when we can be stingy, but for today, I am trying to impress my next cat.’
[If you say so. But you should also learn this skill. Trust me, this is no ordinary sword skill.]
’I will. But for now, it’s my way of entering my master’s pants.’
Kent looked toward Saintess Selene and gave her a wink.
"We will be adding this, too," Kent said, handing the case to the attendant, who quickly checked the price. He was beyond excited.
Selling five legendary-grade items in a single day had never happened before.
In fact, in the past 10 years, he has only sold two legendary-grade skill books. So, selling five at the same time will undoubtedly make him very rich.
"The [Sword Cutter] will cost 70,000,000," the attendant said.
This made Kent’s ladies look at him in shock. Although Vexthra had told them to trust him, spending over 200 million spirit stones was not something they expected.

But Kent, who had more than enough, casually retrieved 220 million spirit stones, which the tower had counted into a pouch, and gave them to the store attendant. He then stored the five cases inside the tower storage.
"It was Nice doing business with you." Before the store attendant could reply, Kent started moving out.
Saintess Selene, Lilian, Unity, and Li Hua followed him. However, Li Hua stopped and eyed the pouch in the store attendant’s hands, causing him to put it away quickly.
Knowing she couldn’t do anything, she followed Kent and the ladies as they headed toward a different store where the tower had identified a Soul-type skill book for Kent.
However, if he didn’t hurry, somebody else would buy it. It was only a heaven-grade skill book, so he had to hurry.
Inside another skill book store, a young man with blonde hair and brown eyes held a green skill book in his hands as he stared back at a middle-aged man who seemed displeased with something.

"Young Master Nash, I have done business with your family before, and that is why I am willing to give you a ten percent discount. My final price is 700,000 Spirit Stones. I can’t go any further down."
The young man smiled slightly before speaking.

"Sir Kai, I know that, but do something about it for me. You know how important soul skills are to my Axel family. Please do something about it for me, and I will put in a good word for you about this year’s Master Alchemist competition."
"I know your niece would love to become a Seeded candidate. I can make that happen," the young man named Nash said, trying to coax the man.
However, Sir Kai didn’t seem to be budging.
The technique the young man was holding was one of the best Soul techniques he had acquired recently.
If the grade had not been inscribed on it, it would have sold for a Legendary-grade technique price.
It’s called [Soul Shock], and as its name suggests, a soul master can tap into it and shock their opponents’ souls.
With enough mastery, Soul strength, and Soul essence, one can use this lone skill to kill an opponent before they even have the chance to retaliate.
Soul attacks are some of the deadliest attacks in cultivation. Without strong soul strength, one can easily die without knowing how it happened.
It is also one of the reasons why Alchemists are feared. Most soul masters are alchemists. The reason is that alchemists require strong souls to handle top-tier pill concoctions.
Because of this, all alchemists strive to become powerful soul masters. In a way, soul masters are the most feared cultivators out there, and having such a skill will, without a doubt, come in handy.
"Sir Kai, are you sure you don’t want to reconsider? You do know my family’s influence, right?" Nash commented, turning the skill book around.

"Are you perhaps trying to threaten me? I have to remind you that this is the Green Gate Bazaar. Threatening a seller is a serious offense, and we wouldn’t want the Bazaar owner to be aware of this, right?" Sir Kai said with a small smile.
However, Nash, who had tried to use his family’s name to threaten him, felt his back break into a cold sweat.
Offending the owner was the last thing he wanted. Not even the King would dare threaten a seller while inside the bazaar.
Nash’s face flushed with embarrassment, but he quickly composed himself. He straightened his posture and forced a smile.
"I apologize, Sir Kai. I didn’t mean to overstep. I was merely suggesting that a deal between us could be mutually beneficial."

He placed the skill book back on the table, his fingers trembling slightly. "I’m not here to cause trouble. But I do believe my family’s resources could make this transaction more... lucrative for both of us."
Sir Kai smiled and took the skill book off the table. He then looked at Nash briefly as if trying to gauge his sincerity.
In the end, he could tell Nash truly wanted the skill. After a few internal struggles, he decided to give in and sell it to him.
However, before he said anything about handing the skill book to Nash, a voice entered the store, immediately making him change his mind.
"I will pay a million spirit stones for the skill book in your hands, Mr."
Kent and the ladies entered the store.

The lady was obsessed with the sword, so if he was going to get inside her pants, he would first have to crush her in the sword’s path.

But for now, it’s my way of entering my master’s pants.’

chapters.title: Chapter 95: It’s Not My Fault You Are Poor
paragraphs: When Kent’s words entered Sir Kai’s ears, his decision to respect Nash’s sincerity about acquiring the [Soul Shock] skill was wiped away.
He was now being offered a million spirit stones instead of the 700,000 Nash had been trying to settle for—and was even willing to compromise on 600,000.
One could say that when money comes into play, even the most sincere and respectful will turn to greed.
Indeed, Kent had picked the right weapon, and at that very moment, Sir Kai’s smile widened, his eyes glinting as he imagined holding a million spirit stones soon.
Kent, followed by Li Hua, Lilian, Unity, and Saintess Selene, stepped confidently into the store.
Nash was already frowning, knowing his chances of acquiring the skill were next to nonexistent. The last thing he wanted was to lose the skill, but as it stood, he was about to lose it.
"Who are you?" Nash asked, glaring at Kent.
He had paid 50,000 spirit stones just to enter the 7th floor of the Bazaar purposely for this skill, and now, as it stood, he was about to lose it to a rather handsome fellow.
This alone made him feel uneasy. Kent’s handsome smile looked ugly at that very moment.
"I am a nobody, but you can call me Master Kent. You can add ’Young’ to it if you feel like ’Master’ is too much," Kent said, extending his hand for a handshake.
Although his face appeared calm, he smiled inwardly at the thought of annoying someone important.
The tower had already appraised the man, and thanks to the enchanted book now merging with him, he knew quite a lot about the young man in front of him.
Kent knew moments like this, the young heirs of these influential families would result in using their names to have their way.
As expected, the young man chose to use his family name to intimidate him.

"I saw this skill book first, and if you don’t know, this skill is something my Axel family is after. I will be pleased with Young Master Kent to let me have this," Nash started in a respectful tone, hoping to appear respectful.
Master Kai curses Nash in his heart for trying to use his Family name to get in the way of his acquiring a million spirit stones.
However, looking at the ladies behind Kent, he knew he was facing someone of class. He only didn’t know which merchant family Kent was from.
The Axel family is a merchant family that focuses on alchemy. Its members are mostly alchemists, and it is one of the strongest merchant families in the human continent.
He just wanted to use that to his advantage, but Kent wasn’t after that. His focus was on the skill book.
"I am sorry, bro, but this skill book is something I need. You can have the next best thing if you want, but I will be taking this off your hands," Kent said, turning toward Master Nash.
"Are you sure you want to do this? If you cross me, my Axel family won’t take this lying down," Nash said, trying a subtle threat.
"Yeah, well, if it had been before, I would have been worried. However, do you know who this beautiful, drop-dead gorgeous woman is?" Kent smiled, gesturing toward Saintess Selene.
"Don’t worry, I’ll tell you. This gorgeous lady is the one and only Sword Saintess Selene, and, well, I am her disciple. So don’t worry, with me hiding under my master’s skirt, I’ll be fine."
Nash’s eyes narrowed, and his face paled slightly when he heard Kent’s words. As for the ladies behind him, they were all hiding their faces.
Only Li Hua seems innocent about the whole situation.
"But I saw this skill first and negotiated a price. You can’t take it just because you have some money," Nash didn’t want to let go of the skill.
"I know. But it’s not my fault you are poor." Kent flashed a grin and pointed backward at his master as if telling Nash the Saintess was still on his side.
He took a few steps back, and then, like an obedient child, he walked away.
It was a rule for many that whenever a situation involved one of the seven Saintesses of the Continent, whether they were right or wrong, they should just retreat.
Angering them was just plain stupid. In fact, Saintess Selene could have used her authority to bring down the Ashland family a peg, but that would just be another war she wouldn’t want to fight.

If and when Kent reached that crossroads, she would stand beside him, but for now, she could just use her presence to intimidate those who might have the wrong idea about her disciple—someone she had started to see in a different light.
’Shameless, absolutely shameless. To think he wouldn’t bat an eye using me as his shield. Is that the level I have been lowered to?’
She couldn’t believe it. But the person in question was dangling a pouch filled with a million spirit stones before Master Kai.
"To tell you the truth, I am actually after legendary-grade skills, so if you have any, bring them out. However, you can hand over the one in your hands first."
He tossed the stones to him and received the skill book. He quickly appraised it.
[Skill Name: Soul Shock]
[Grade: Heaven]
[Rank: SSS]
[Effect:]
-- Releases a devastating wave of soul energy capable of stunning and crippling enemies.
-- Causes excruciating pain and shatters weaker souls entirely.
-- Targets multiple enemies within a 500-meter range.
-- Enemies with strong souls will suffer reduced effects but lose combat focus.
’Good one. No wonder poor Nash wanted it. I guess I didn’t want a million for it. Once I upgrade it to the Legendary grade, it will become even more devastating.’

Kent tossed the skill into the Tower storage, where it would be safe for the time being. Sir Kai, who had just received the million spirit stones, became ecstatic and ran to bring the Legendary-grade skills in his possession for Kent.
In the meantime, the Saintess dragged Kent to the side and whispered.
"What are you doing?" Saintess Selene asked.
"Nothing. I just thought, why not take three beauties to town and spoil them?" Kent smiled.
"Tell me what you are really doing," she asked again.
"Nothing, as I said. But if you insist, then I can just say I’m being generous so I can get close to you. Do you think I have a shot?" Kent asked, stepping closer to her.
Lilian and Unity watched out of the corner of their eyes as they giggled inwardly. They had already started reporting everything to Vexthra, who was giving them instructions on how to proceed.
Saintess Selene took a step back and firmed herself, determined not to lose her grip and fall under Kent’s charm.

Kent smiled and stepped back. "You might want to use this chance to get all the skills you want. In the future, I’ll depend on you to save me when I get into trouble." With that, Kent moved back to give her breathing space.

A few minutes later, Sir Kai came out with eight Legendary-grade skills for Kent and his ladies to select from. He spent 120 million there for four more skills. Two went to Lilian, one to Unity, and the other to Saintess Selene.
They then went to the weapons store to buy a bow for Unity.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Void Piercing Demon Arrow
paragraphs: "I will take this one," Unity said, taking a golden bow from the shelf. It’s a Heaven-Grade Bow that adapts to any and all elements.
Kent quickly appraised it.
[Name: Sky Piercing Bow]
[Grade: Heaven]
[Type: Weapon]
[Abilities:]
-- Fires arrows infused with pure elemental energy.
-- All arrows fired ignore 30% defense of any kind.
-- The user can lock onto targets within a 10-mile radius.
-- Draw speed increases with the user’s willpower.
"Not bad. Not bad at all," Kent said, checking out the bow. He didn’t know much about weapons, but with his appraisal ability, he could learn all about a weapon without even trying.
"How much is this, Madam Fei?" Kent asked the store lady, who was pleased with Unity’s choice. After all, it was a Heaven-Grade weapon, one of the most expensive items in her store.
"That will be 1.2 million spirit stones. Also, before you pay for that, I would like you to see something first."
Madam Fei smiled and retrieved a slim, 3-foot-long rectangular box from her space ring. The moment the box came out of her ring, Kent felt an immediate attraction to it.
Of course, he appraised it, but it only showed the details of the ordinary box. This meant he was attracted to the item inside.
"What is it?" Kent asked, showing no sign of attraction to the item in the box. He wouldn’t make it obvious for Madam Fei to overcharge him.
Madam Fei opened it and revealed the item inside the rectangular box.
It’s an arrow—a bone arrow, to be precise.
But it has fractures inside it, showing it’s damaged. However, Kent felt a strong pull toward the arrow for some reason.
This made him raise an eyebrow in a way that suggested the nature of the bow took him aback. He wasn’t about to make it evident to Madam Fei that he could tell the true value of the arrow.
"A subordinate brought it back from the Ancient Battlefield of Parting. They said they found it inside a pile of bones belonging to wild monsters.
"I don’t really know its true value, but I know things from the Ancient Battlefield of Parting hold great value," Madam Fei explained.
"Ancient Battlefield of Parting?" Kent furrowed his brow. The name sounded interesting, but until he saw it, the Kingdom Building Enchanted book couldn’t tell him anything.
Luckily, Madam Fei was in the mood to share.

"The Ancient Battlefield of Parting was said to be a great battlefield many thousands of years ago between the various races of this world. It was said that before the Parting, all races lived in one large world with nothing separating them.
"However, the demons and a few races like the elves, dragons, and Beastkin saw the other races as inferior and tried to suppress them.
This led to a massive battle that lasted for 100 days. It was said that during those 100 days of battle, many powerhouses rose and fell in a carnage of blood and steel.

The battle was so devastating that the world was on the brink of dying. But in the final moments, the gods intervened and divided it into different continents, separating them with borders that were hard to cross.

However, to prevent the continents from being completely cut off from each other—after all, some had banded together to survive—the gods sealed the battlefield and created portals connecting the various continents.

It was said that the gods left their blessing on the battlefield, imbuing it with treasures of great value. Rumor even has it that if you are lucky, you might gain powerful weapons or witness some of the skills used during the battle.
It’s a place the brave venture to explore, so you can see why I said anything from that place is of great value."
Madam Fei looked back at Kent, hoping deep in her heart that he would find interest in the damaged arrow.
"Tower, remind me to pay a visit to that place," Kent said to the tower.
[Already looking forward to it, Master,] the tower responded.
"How much do you want for it? Although it’s damaged, it will be a great addition to my collection." Kent chose to play the role of a collector.
These beings only buy to add to their collection but never truly use it.
Hearing he knew not much of the arrow, Madam Fei smiled and spoke the price. "I was planning on sending it to an auction, but since you seem to like it, you can add 50,000 spirit stones to the bow."

"Here you go, and please, in case you ever receive more items from this ancient battlefield, reach out to me. I would love to buy and add it to my collection," Kent said, handing over the pouch containing the spirit stones to Madam Fei.

He then put the arrow and bow in his tower storage. He had appraised the arrow, and while he couldn’t use it now, that didn’t mean he couldn’t use it in the future. In fact, if the existence of this arrow is made known to the world, many will flip.
"You can find me at the Divine Palace Sect. By the way, my name is Kent. Kent Madson." Kent flashed a cute smile at Madam Fei before he left with the ladies.
[The master has exceeded my expectations. Your acting skills are top-notch,] the tower commented, seeing how well Kent acted when presented with the arrow.
’What can I say? I have a good grasp on actors. So it’s only natural for me to have the aura of an actor.’ Kent grinned and turned to the ladies with him.
He retrieved three pouches and handed them to Unity, Lilian, and Saintess Selene.

"Here are a hundred million spirit stones each. You can visit any herb store and buy the herbs and treasures you need for body tempering. We will all start tempering our bodies from now onwards," he said, turning to Li Hua.
"Even little Li Hua here will also start tempering her cute little body," Kent smiled.
"Isn’t this too much?" Saintess Selene asked, holding the hundred million in her palm.
"Don’t overthink it, Master. You are now my Master, and it’s only natural for me to temper your body. And who knows when that body will be put to good use in ways you would never expect.
"You ladies should smile and rejoice. Being in the care of a Handsome, Cute, Extraordinary, and Handsome rich man like me should be a blessing."
Kent laughed and started walking away. He already had things to do, and one of those was the arrow in his possession.
One might not place much value on the arrow at first glance, but as someone who could see the nature of things, Kent knew he had chanced upon a trump card he would use in the coming years.
Who knows? His life might just depend on it.
He kept humming a happy tune as he explored the herb stores, gathering herbs and resources for body tempering and alchemy.
Finally, he could start tempering his body as he and Vexthra had discussed. He would have to start now if he wanted to have a shot at becoming immortal one day.
[Name: Void Piercing Demon Arrow]
[Grade: Spiritual (Damaged)]
[Type: Weapon]
-- The Forbidden Arrow of the Great General Rumil.
-- An arrow said to capture the souls of ten thousand demons and the soul of the Ancient 8-headed Hydra Serpent.
-- An arrow capable of slaying a god.
