"What is it?" Kent asked, showing no sign of attraction to the item in the box.
He wouldn’t make it obvious for Madam Fei to overcharge him.
Madam Fei opened it and revealed the item inside the rectangular box.
It’s an arrow—a bone arrow, to be precise.
But it has fractures inside it, showing it’s damaged.
However, Kent felt a strong pull toward the arrow for some reason.
This made him raise an eyebrow in a way that suggested the nature of the bow took him aback.
He wasn’t about to make it evident to Madam Fei that he could tell the true value of the arrow.
"A subordinate brought it back from the Ancient Battlefield of Parting.
They said they found it inside a pile of bones belonging to wild monsters.
"I don’t really know its true value, but I know things from the Ancient Battlefield of Parting hold great value," Madam Fei explained.
"Ancient Battlefield of Parting?" Kent furrowed his brow.
The name sounded interesting, but until he saw it, the Kingdom Building Enchanted book couldn’t tell him anything.
Luckily, Madam Fei was in the mood to share.
"The Ancient Battlefield of Parting was said to be a great battlefield many thousands of years ago between the various races of this world.
It was said that before the Parting, all races lived in one large world with nothing separating them.
"However, the demons and a few races like the elves, dragons, and Beastkin saw the other races as inferior and tried to suppress them.
This led to a massive battle that lasted for 100 days.
It was said that during those 100 days of battle, many powerhouses rose and fell in a carnage of blood and steel.
The battle was so devastating that the world was on the brink of dying.
But in the final moments, the gods intervened and divided it into different continents, separating them with borders that were hard to cross.

However, to prevent the continents from being completely cut off from each other—after all, some had banded together to survive—the gods sealed the battlefield and created portals connecting the various continents.
It was said that the gods left their blessing on the battlefield, imbuing it with treasures of great value.
Rumor even has it that if you are lucky, you might gain powerful weapons or witness some of the skills used during the battle.
It’s a place the brave venture to explore, so you can see why I said anything from that place is of great value."
Madam Fei looked back at Kent, hoping deep in her heart that he would find interest in the damaged arrow.
"Tower, remind me to pay a visit to that place," Kent said to the tower.
[Already looking forward to it, Master,] the tower responded.
"How much do you want for it?
Although it’s damaged, it will be a great addition to my collection." Kent chose to play the role of a collector.
These beings only buy to add to their collection but never truly use it.
Hearing he knew not much of the arrow, Madam Fei smiled and spoke the price.
"I was planning on sending it to an auction, but since you seem to like it, you can add 50,000 spirit stones to the bow."
"Here you go, and please, in case you ever receive more items from this ancient battlefield, reach out to me.
I would love to buy and add it to my collection," Kent said, handing over the pouch containing the spirit stones to Madam Fei.
He then put the arrow and bow in his tower storage.
He had appraised the arrow, and while he couldn’t use it now, that didn’t mean he couldn’t use it in the future.
In fact, if the existence of this arrow is made known to the world, many will flip.
"You can find me at the Divine Palace Sect.
By the way, my name is Kent.
Kent Madson." Kent flashed a cute smile at Madam Fei before he left with the ladies.
[The master has exceeded my expectations.
Your acting skills are top-notch,] the tower commented, seeing how well Kent acted when presented with the arrow.
’What can I say?
I have a good grasp on actors.
So it’s only natural for me to have the aura of an actor.’ Kent grinned and turned to the ladies with him.
He retrieved three pouches and handed them to Unity, Lilian, and Saintess Selene.
"Here are a hundred million spirit stones each.
You can visit any herb store and buy the herbs and treasures you need for body tempering.
We will all start tempering our bodies from now onwards," he said, turning to Li Hua.
"Even little Li Hua here will also start tempering her cute little body," Kent smiled.
"Isn’t this too much?" Saintess Selene asked, holding the hundred million in her palm.
"Don’t overthink it, Master.
You are now my Master, and it’s only natural for me to temper your body.
And who knows when that body will be put to good use in ways you would never expect.
"You ladies should smile and rejoice.
Being in the care of a Handsome, Cute, Extraordinary, and Handsome rich man like me should be a blessing."
Kent laughed and started walking away.
He already had things to do, and one of those was the arrow in his possession.
One might not place much value on the arrow at first glance, but as someone who could see the nature of things, Kent knew he had chanced upon a trump card he would use in the coming years.
Who knows?
His life might just depend on it.
He kept humming a happy tune as he explored the herb stores, gathering herbs and resources for body tempering and alchemy.
Finally, he could start tempering his body as he and Vexthra had discussed.
He would have to start now if he wanted to have a shot at becoming immortal one day.
[Name: Void Piercing Demon Arrow]
[Grade: Spiritual (Damaged)]
[Type: Weapon]
-- The Forbidden Arrow of the Great General Rumil.
-- An arrow said to capture the souls of ten thousand demons and the soul of the Ancient 8-headed Hydra Serpent.
-- An arrow capable of slaying a god.

chapters.title: Chapter 97: What Are Your Intentions Toward Me
paragraphs: After giving the ladies 100 million each, Kent parted with them to buy his own share of herbs for body tempering. Of course, Li Hua wasn’t happy about not receiving a million of her own, but she understood she wasn’t there yet.
Kent went to dozens of stores, looking to buy some of the best herbs he and the Tower could come up with. With loads of knowledge about alchemy in his mind, the process was much smoother.
Before leaving the God Realm, Vexthra advised him to get into body tempering. The reason was simple.
According to her, the earlier one gets into body tempering, the easier it will be for them when they reach the stage to become immortals.
They would have to temper their bodies in powerful treasures in order to form immortal qi, so tempering from the beginner stage is the best.
Of course, it’s very expensive, but with his current wealth, tempering with the best and most expensive treasures isn’t going to be a problem.
Since that was the case, he wasn’t about to let his wives and future ones lack in that regard. So he threw in 300 million spirit stones for them to use.
Of course, he trusted Lilian and Unity to know what to buy. After all, they had a direct line of contact with a Goddess, so knowing what to buy and what not to buy wasn’t going to be a problem.

Kent knew that when he managed to get such a link to Vexthra, he wouldn’t have to worry about anything ever again. But then, once he awakened the Tower upon reaching the grandmaster stage, everything would become easy for him.
Lilian and Unity visited many stores and spent 5 million spirit stones each, filling their space rings to the brim.
They never expected their lives to turn out this way, but thanks to Kent, they were now living the life of the rich and wealthy.
Of course, they planned to reward him with four rounds each when they returned.
As for Saintess Selene, although she was having a hard time taking Kent’s money, Li Hua didn’t allow her to back away from spending it.
In the end, Selene bought 4 million worth of herbs, and Li Hua spent a million on herself, as she also wanted to start tempering her delicate, tiny body.

With her future as an overpowered assassin set in stone, the least Kent could do was make her even more overpowered before she awakened her class and started laying waste to those who stood in her way.
After everything was done, Kent left with them and returned to the mansion. He wanted to visit a particular manager and perhaps bounce her ass for a few rounds before heading back.
But since he came with others, he postponed that plan.

He would return later to have some fun. For now, he planned to tie up some loose ends before using the compass to enter the God Realm and spend time with Vexthra, who would undoubtedly be shocked to see him.
When they returned to the mansion, Saintess Selene dragged Kent away to talk to him. Lilian and Unity took Li Hua aside to get to know her better.
It was their first time having alone time with her, and since they couldn’t talk much on their way to the bazaar, they decided to use this time to learn more about her.
After dragging Kent away, Saintess Selene led him to her room. Once inside, she let go of his hand and turned to face him.
"Tell me, why are you doing this?" she asked, looking deep into his eyes.
"You might want to clarify more, Master. What do you mean by what am I doing?" Kent replied, also gazing back at her, a smile playing on his lips.
"Don’t act dumb, Kent," Saintess Selene said with a frown. "You know what I mean. Why are you spending so much money on me? What are your intentions toward me?"
Kent smiled and smirked. "You are my master, and as your disciple, it’s only natural for me to spend money on you."

Kent didn’t mind spending money on her. He saw it as an investment for future gains. However, since he knew his master wouldn’t get angry, he failed to recognize the seriousness of Saintess Selene’s question.
But his cheeky answer made Saintess Selene shudder in anger, and she subconsciously unleashed her Peak Root Sage aura.
In an instant, Kent turned pale and dropped to his knees, gasping for air. The aura was thick and suffocating, making him feel like his soul was slowly leaving his body.

Then, just as suddenly, the aura vanished, and a pair of delicate hands steadied him. Kent immediately felt a surge of potent energy flowing into his body. The energy brought some color back to his face and filled him with vitality.
"I am sorry, Kent. I never meant to hurt you. I was just angry and subconsciously unleashed my aura. I am sorry," Saintess Selene said, looking very guilty.
For a minute there, she lost her grip and nearly killed her precious disciple.
"I know you didn’t mean to hurt me, Master," Kent said, using her as support to get back up. "It was my fault for angering you. I am sorry," Kent said, forcing out a smile.
This sight broke Saintess Selene’s heart. She had wanted to know why Kent was spoiling her rotten, but in the process, she instead nearly killed her disciple.
But she wasn’t the only one having a thought. Kent was also having a moment of clarity and awakening.
Just now, he felt how weak he was, and for a moment, he got a reality check. He wasn’t invincible.
[Come on, bro. You are the man. Teach this cat who the tiger is.] Of course, the shameless Tower wouldn’t let Kent lose his pride.
It had planned to use Kent’s soul strength to teleport him away if things went sideways. Thankfully, Saintess Selene got back to her senses within seconds.
Kent sighed in his heart and chose to be Kent again.
Suddenly, he grabbed Saintess Selene by the waist and dragged her toward him, leaving no space between them. He looked into her eyes and smiled.

"You asked what my intentions are toward you. Well, my answer is simple. I want to get inside your pants. I want to pin you down on my bed and ravage you while you call me Master. And if that is not enough, I will make you sing it.
You should also know I plan on making you my woman. I plan on making you someone I can trust with my soul, and I plan to make you happy, strong, and capable.
So don’t worry. If a million is not enough, I will give you a billion. All you have to do is keep being my amazing master, who will soon become my woman.
And hey, if you are one of those fantasy women who are already betrothed to another man, don’t worry. I will sever their heads from their bodies to have you all to myself.
You can’t escape my claws, Master, so prepare your voice to sing when it happens."
Kent flashed another smile, lowered his hands to her ass, and gave her a gentle squeeze.
The next second, he teleported away, leaving a flustered Saintess who lost control of her body from just a few words and a gentle squeeze of her ass.

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Getting His Reward
paragraphs: When Kent teleported, he appeared inside his room, about 40 meters from Saintess Selene. Now that his teleport skill had been upgraded to [Blink], he could teleport anywhere he had seen or imagined.
This meant that if his divine sense detected a place within a 5000-meter radius, he could teleport there. It was a significant upgrade from the previous one.
When he appeared in the room, he sat on his bed and sighed deeply.

The events that had just happened were a lot to take in. In fact, Kent never expected things to escalate that wildly, that quickly. But things happened, and in a way, he had just revealed his plans to his master, who was left flustered.
While that was a bold move on his part, he also started to realize he was not that strong and could be killed at any moment.

The fact that his master’s aura managed to bring him to his knees was enough to tell him he wasn’t invincible. Without a doubt, he was very weak, and at that moment, he understood that. He knew he was weak—very weak, in fact.
"This is bad. I need to get stronger, much stronger," Kent said, re-evaluating his stance.
"Then, on the other hand, if I manage to get inside my master’s pants, I’ll soon become a powerhouse through sex. Won’t that be awesome?" Kent laughed.
[No need to look smug, master. This is just the start for you. Your master will need much more convincing to get to that point.]
The tower dropped its point of view. However, Kent wasn’t about to let the shameless tower rain on his parade.
But he knew he had to put in the work. He had to ensure things between them got steamy, and for that to happen, he needed to get stronger and do amazing things.

These were the kinds of achievements that would raise his status to the point where his master wouldn’t be able to deny him access. But who cared about that? After all, they would always be indoors and together, so he wouldn’t have to worry about it.

"I need to get my affairs in order and go with Master to the sect soon. There’s a lot to be done, and there, I’ll be able to get much closer to her." After setting his affairs in order, he lay down on the bed.
"Hey, Tower, shouldn’t you reward me for being brave and awesome?" Kent asked with a small smile.
[Don’t overestimate yourself, Master. But while your shamelessness is shocking, I must admit that you were awesome, so I will reward you.]
An item entered the Tower storage, and Kent retrieved it.
"Random Item Bingo Card," Kent read aloud, inspecting the name on the card and appraising it.
[Random Item Bingo Card]
-- By channelling your energy into this card, you will receive a random item that can be gold or trash if your luck is high. It all depends on your luck.
"What a cheat item. This means I can get nothing of value or something incredibly valuable," Kent muttered, then decided to test his luck.
He channelled his energy into the card, which caught fire briefly before an item appeared in his palm.
He quickly appraised it.
[Wealth Dice (One-Time Use Item)]
-- A one-time-use dice with six different faces.
-- Roll the dice by channelling your energy into it. Whatever face appears, your wealth (Spirit Stones) will be multiplied by that number.
"Looks like this one’s gold. At least I won’t lose anything if I get a one, so I can only hope to roll higher numbers and multiply my wealth," Kent sighed. Then, with a flick, he rolled the dice.
The next second, the winning face appeared—it was a four.
[You have rolled a four. Do you want your wealth to be multiplied now or later?]
"Let’s do it now, buddy," Kent said with a small smile. While he didn’t mind the idea of unlimited wealth, he knew he’d need much more with more ladies and people joining his tower.
Because of this, he planned to become rich, and using his riches, he could destroy whoever dared to threaten him.

Right now, Li Hua was safe from the Ashland Noble Family, but he knew that wouldn’t last forever. So, he resolved to use his wealth to grow and ensure those close to him also became stronger so he wouldn’t have to worry about their safety all the time.
[Current Wealth: 2.5 Trillion. Wealth has been multiplied by 4.]
[Current Wealth: 10 Trillion. Good luck.]

"That’s more like it. With this, I won’t need to worry about money for the next few years," Kent sighed. He then reviewed the tasks he needed to complete before using the compass to travel to the God Realm.
At the moment, his sword intent, sword qi, and sword body make him someone at the peak of the Sword Master stage. However, he was still lacking in one aspect.
According to the tower’s requirement, he was to practice the 10,002 Sword Plays, strengthening his sword intent and qi.
He would have to practice all 10,002 before being recognized as a Sword Master by the tower. His current progress looks like this:
[Sword Play Progress: 4,000/10,002]
He still had a long way to go and just two weeks to accomplish that before leaving with his master for the sect.
The other plan was to concoct the remaining 60 Tier 2 pills to complete the second out of four requirements for becoming a Pill Grandmaster.

The third requirement could be handled during the Master Alchemist competition in three months. As for the last one, which involved concocting a Tier 3 pill, now that he was rich, he could easily buy a recipe and the necessary ingredients.
Then, aside from that, there was the compass to enter the god realm. He had the spirit stone to pay and the soul bead to charge it for now.
He was only holding back because of what happened during the battle at the Makosa Prison—how he had killed a Root Sage without knowing how.
He wanted to figure that out first before getting into anything else. He also held himself back from doing anything drastic that would endanger him and those close to him.
So, while he would love nothing more than to storm the Ashland Family and start a slaughter, he knew that was a bad idea.
For the next three days, he will focus on alchemy while waiting for the tower to render the recording of what truly happened during the battle at the Makosa Prison.
He moved to his workstation, retrieved the cauldron, and started concocting pills. His first one came out 98% pure, but after two more trials, he pushed it to 100%.
Meanwhile, after Lilian and Unity returned Li Hua to Saintess Selene, they left to go talk to her mother, who had been caught peeking at them during their intimate session with Kent.
Lilian knew if she didn’t do anything, her mom wouldn’t do anything and continue to hold herself back.
If only she had known that, had she held herself back for a long time, things would have gone haywire quickly.

He moved to his workstation, retrieved the cauldron, and started concocting pills.
His first one came out 98% pure, but after two more trials, he pushed it to 100%.
Meanwhile, after Lilian and Unity returned Li Hua to Saintess Selene, they left to go talk to her mother, who had been caught peeking at them during their intimate session with Kent.

paragraphs: "Are we really going to do this? Are we actually going to do this?" Unity asked as she and Lilian moved toward Lady Cynthia’s mansion.
"Yes. I want Mom to have some fun too. I know Kent wouldn’t mind at all," Lilian responded with a small smile.
She and Unity had thought hard about approaching this, but in the end, they first spoke with Vexthra, who was very happy with the development.
Lady Cynthia is a Root Saint at the 4th level. If she were to cultivate with Kent, he would break through to the Root Grandmaster stage after a few rounds.
Vexthra had explained how having intimacy with stronger women would help Kent, and because of this, the two ladies chose to become agents working to bring these women to him.
Of course, they planned to talk to Kent and let him know the rewards they would receive for their efforts.
As people who wanted nothing more than to remain his women and forever bask in favour of a goddess, Lilian and Unity were beyond happy to add more women to the list.
Whether Kent made these women his own and added them to his harem, they didn’t care. The more women who joined the harem, the more joy Vexthra, who was lonely in the God Realm, would feel.

"I suppose this is okay. Lady Cynthia has been lonely for a long time. Having some fun will go a long way," Unity said. As someone who had been a maid since childhood, she knew what happens in the Alderford family.
Cynthia, John’s wife, had endured years of emotional neglect. Once a charming and devoted husband, John had grown cold and distant over time.
His obsession with his business ventures and his relentless ambition had driven a wedge between them.

What started as late nights in the study had turned into weeks spent away on "important trips," leaving Cynthia alone in a vast mansion with only fleeting messages to remind her she was still someone’s wife.
However, the worst was John’s dismissive attitude toward Cynthia’s feelings. He rarely listened when she spoke, brushing off her concerns as trivial or unworthy of his attention.

At gatherings, he barely acknowledged her presence, often using her as a prop to enhance his social image. The man who once held her hand during every storm now stood on the other side of the chasm, indifferent to her pain.

It wasn’t just the loneliness that ate away at Cynthia but the bitter realization that she had become invisible in her own marriage. Her beauty, her wit, her warmth—all of it seemed wasted on a man who no longer saw her.
Unity, having witnessed these quiet tragedies unfold behind closed doors, couldn’t help but feel sympathy for Lady Cynthia.
’She deserves better,’ Unity thought to herself. ’She deserves to feel wanted again, to remember what it’s like to laugh, be held, and feel alive.’
She looks at Lilian’s back and sighs. ’I won’t say anything since that bitch is dead. I guess the secret now dies with her forever.’ Unity sighed again.
She knew about the relationship between John and Lady Olive. While that is a common secret among the maids, she knows something else, and for peace, she will hold that thought for now.
If only she knew not saying anything now would backfire in a few days.

And so, as she and Lilian neared the grand gates of Lady Cynthia’s mansion, Unity’s resolve hardened. If this could bring a spark of happiness back into Cynthia’s life, even for a moment, then perhaps it was worth the risk.
"Mom, open the door. It’s me and Unity. We need to talk," Lilian called out as they approached the mansion’s door.
"Go away, Lilian. I don’t want to talk," Cynthia replied from behind the locked door. She had confined herself to her room for hours, unable to face her daughter after what she had done.

"Come on, Mom. This is nothing to be worried about. I don’t blame you. In fact, we’re here to talk to you about something important," Lilian reassured her, her tone patient and calm as she waited for a response.
A minute passed in silence before the door creaked open. Lilian and Unity stepped inside, and as soon as they entered, Cynthia shut the door behind them and hurried back to her bed.
Cynthia’s beauty was undeniable. Though Lilian and Unity would never admit it out loud, she was far more striking than them.
Her figure was exquisitely developed, with a shapely elegance that drew attention. Her chest was fuller, her curves more pronounced, and her allure seemed effortless.
Even by comparison, Cynthia’s figure rivalled Manager Alina’s, though slightly less exaggerated. She had an undeniable charm that exuded maturity and sensuality.
In short, there was no doubt Kent would find her irresistible, her presence commanding attention in any scenario.
He would love to put her on her knees and project that ass out.
"Mom, we need to talk," Lilian said as she settled on the bed.
"I know. And before you say anything, I would first like to apologize for peeking into your private affairs. I don’t know what came over me," Cynthia apologized with an embarrassed expression.
"No need to apologize, Mom, it’s okay. In fact, we came here to tell you we have a plan for you to experience that," Lilian said, leaning closer to her mom.
In truth, Lilian wanted her mom to become one of their sisters. The reason was simple: she wanted her destiny to change like hers had.

After becoming sisters with a goddess, her destiny had taken a rather good turn, and it was for the best. If her mom joined them, she would be very happy. As to whether her father would say anything, Lilian, just like Unity, also had dirt on him.
The Alderford family looked functional on the surface but was very dysfunctional inwardly. The only saving grace was that John’s concubines weren’t living in the Alderford Mansion.
That was the only saving grace. Things would have turned upside down if it had been any different. Kent wouldn’t have met Lilian and Unity.
"Dont talk nonsense Lilian," Cynthia said, looking at her daughter with the corner of her eyes.

"I am not talking nonsense, Mom. Although I am not around more often, I know things arent going well for you. But that can be fix. All you have to do is listen to us. If you don’t want it, we wont force you," Lilian said, gaining some attention.
"Now, before we start, I will only ask this once. Your answer will depend on whether we continue this discussion or not." Lilian made her stance clear.
Cynthia nodded and knew she was about to do something she never in a million years would expert herself doing. However, while it seemed wrong in her eyes, her heart was saying something different.
Especially when she saw how thick and long Kent’s dick was. She wanted it inside of her, and for that, she would become a naughty girl for that thickness to slide in and out of her tiny cave.
"My question is simple: Do you want to experience what you saw."

chapters.title: Chapter 100: What Truly Happened
paragraphs: Kent’s cauldron puffed, sending out dark smoke as yet another pill successfully formed—the 30th in the last three days.
He retrieved it and carefully placed it in a jade pill bottle. He planned to save them until his next visit to Manager Alina to hand them over.
He had already concluded that pills below the Tier 3 stage were no longer worthy in his eyes. His focus was now firmly set on Tier 3 and above.

That was the threshold where he would finally step into the realm of true pill-making. It would mark the stage where he could be called a Pill Grandmaster, someone with the power to suppress even a Merchant Family and become untouchable.
He had already concocted all 60 Tier 1 pills, and now, he was left with 30 more to complete the second requirement that required him to concoct another 60 Tier 2 pills.
"Tower, how much time remains before the requirements are due?" Kent asked. The tower had set a time limit for him to complete four requirements before earning the title of Pill Grandmaster.
[You still have five months and two weeks,] the tower responded.
"Good. At least I have more time before the Pill Master competition in three months," Kent sighed. He stored away the cauldron.
He then went to wash his hands, scrubbing away the lingering smell of pills, before returning to focus on his main agenda.
The tower informed him an hour ago that it was done rendering the video of what truly happened during his rescue mission in Makosa Mine.

Since he somehow managed to kill a Root Sage, he wanted to know how that was possible. Luckily, his reason for recording and playing his battle for his master to show how awesome he is has captured something rather intriguing.
"Tower, play the video," Kent said. Suddenly, like a Virtual Reality headset, the video appeared; however, the most intriguing thing was that he had a third-person view of the situation.
"Tower, play from where the lady appeared," Kent said, and like it was instructed, the video fast forward to the scene when Lady Sandra appeared.
She attacked, and Kent defended.
"Who are you?" Kent asked
"The question should be, who are you, young man? I’ve encountered many humans with great potential, but none quite like you," the masked woman said coldly. She then moved closer to Kent.
Kent instinctively took a few steps back.
"Tell me, young man, what is your name?" the woman asked.
"I asked the question first," Kent replied, his gaze steady on the woman. He knew he couldn’t defeat her but refused to cower before her.
"A bold one, huh? I like that," she said. "Initially, I planned to kill you since I can’t leave any witnesses when I claim the Atomic Divine Body. But I’ve changed my mind.
"With your potential, having you as my slave would be far more advantageous. So, human, will you become my slave willingly, or do you prefer the hard way?"
The moment Kent heard her question, something shifted within him. "What did you just say?" he asked, his voice chilling as the temperature around them dropped.
Suddenly, Kent’s eyes darkened, and his aura surged wildly. The dark-robed lady, Lady Sandra, immediately became alarmed and moved to knock him out.
However, as she came within range, Kent swung his sword precisely, forcing her to jump back in fright.
"You dare threaten to enslave me? Do you even know who I am?" Kent roared, his voice filled with unrestrained fury. He sent Lady Sandra hurtling several meters through the air with a powerful punch.
Before she could hit the ground, Kent teleported, immediately appearing behind her.
"Do you have any idea who you are threatening?" he shouted again, his voice thunderous as he landed another punch, this time on her stomach.
"I am the Chaos Lord, the bringer of chaos, and you dare threaten to enslave me?" he bellowed, his rage palpable. A third punch smashed into her ribcage, forcing her to cough up a mouthful of blood.
"How bold. To think a mere mortal would threaten to enslave me, the Dragon King." This time, his hand transformed into a dragon claw and swiped at her chest, sending her flying back once more.

He moved again, but this time, a dense sword intent, having transcended the 9th stage and finally stepping into Sword Will, burst out of his body as he gazed coldly at the lady coughing up blood on the ground.
"In all my existence as the first-ever Sword Sage, this is the first time I’ve encountered a mortal who thinks she has what it takes to enslave me. How bold."
He moved forward and thrust his sword through her chest.
"In your next life, learn never to threaten anyone with slavery. Not even gods would dare to threaten me with such, let alone a mortal like you. How bold."
Kent formed a seal, and runic strings attached themselves to Lady Sandra’s soul. Soon, a soul bead formed, and he used a secret technique to enhance its power.
A few seconds later, his eyes returned to their usual purple hue.
The video ended there, and Kent was brought back to his senses. He gasped for breath the moment he came out.
"That was intense," Kent commented, feeling his brain numb momentarily. He sat down and took the next few minutes to recollect his thoughts.

"The Chaos Lord, the Dragon King, and the Sword Sage. Was I really that awesome in my past life?" Kent wondered, recalling how domineering, arrogant, and powerful he had felt while watching the video.
"Was I truly that awesome?" Kent’s excitement was palpable, the memories sparking a joy he’d never experienced before. Now that he had seen what happened, something shifted within him.

It was as if he had suddenly become fearless, brimming with energy. At that moment, he felt like the domineering Dragon King, the immensely powerful and wrathful Chaos Lord, and the elegant yet sinister Sword Sage all at once.
"Tower, what’s your take on this?" Kent asked.
[Master, you have indeed assumed three past incarnations when triggered back then.]
"You think being threatened with slavery was the trigger, huh?" Kent asked.
[Indeed. I tracked the master’s pulses throughout the fight. Just when the lady threatened to make you her slave, your pulse dropped before suddenly spiking.
I believe the trigger is closely tied to being threatened with slavery.]
"I see. In that case, I need to find a way to remember more of my past. I want to feel like that again," Kent said, determination flashing in his eyes.
Kent was beyond happy. For reasons unknown, he felt as though his life had been far more extraordinary than the one he lived back on Earth—or even the one he was living now.

It felt as if he was destined for something greater, and having just witnessed his domineering past self, Kent was more than ready to uncover more about who he had been and how to reclaim the immense power he had once demonstrated.
"Tower, keep tracking my pulse. Whenever I go dark, record everything. I want to know more," Kent declared, his resolve solidifying.
He wanted to remember. Of course, the cost of uncovering his past would reveal itself soon enough.
